tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yang dus mdos gtong tshul ni/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i phyag deb lhan cig tu bsgrigs nas tshig tshogs phyung zhing gsal byed rim par bkod na/ de yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i chog bsgrigs phyag deb las// swasti/ bla ma rje btsun sa lo chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdan sa chen po'i dus mdos 'di ni/ spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi rim/ sde dpon rigs rnams kyi sku rim/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa sde gdung brgyud dang bcas pa'i sku rim la dmigs te/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i sku thog la/ sngags nag bla chen stag tsha dang / bon nag re sa dzu gur gnyis la dmigs te nub phyogs la gnang zhing khong gnyis lo dang zla ba'i dus ma 'gyangs par tshe'i dus byas nas rnam smin gyi phung po gnyis 'dir phyag tu 'byor/ bla chen stag tsha'i snying sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i zhal gdong gi 'brub khung du mdze thod nyis brtsegs thun khung dang bcas pa'i 'og tu dgug gzhug lha dbye sogs rgyas par mdzad nas bcug phung po byings rnams sgo rum gyi them pa'i 'og sogs so sor mnan pa dang / re sa dzu gur gyi phung po sa skya tshogs kyi nub sgo'i chu 'gram du mnan pa'i las sogs mthar phyin pa mdzad/ steng du mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba bzhengs te mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing / bkra shis dang dge legs kyi dpal 'bar te deng sang gi bar du dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa 'di yin/ de'i rjes su chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i sku ring la 'bri gung pas zhabs 'dren sgrub la brten/ mdos gtor shar phyogs la gnang ba de yin zhing / de rjes dbus gong mas lha khang chen mo sogs phrogs/ dngul gar lugs las byas pa'i rten gsum thams cad bshigs ste mdzo khal lnga bcus drangs pa dang /

yang shel dang hor shel khyad par can las grub pa'i mchod cha khyad nor rten gsum ngo mtshar ba/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan la sogs pa thams cad drangs/ lha khang chen mo'i rten gsum la phug ron la sogs pa'i bya yis gnod pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ dkar khung tshang ma la shing drwa khyad par can yod pa rnams kyang mes bus te rlog par byed pa sogs mtshams med kyi las tshad med bsgrubs pa la brten/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos gtso mdzad gdan sa bka' bgros pa rnams kyis dbus gong ma la dmigs nas shar la bsgyur ba'i rgyun deng sang gi bar du 'jags pa yin zhing / don la dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa sde dang bcas pa la gnod par byed mkhan gyi dgra bo gang na yod pa'i sa phyogs la gtor kha ston dgos rgyu gong gi lo rgyus kyis gsal/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi sku tshe'i stod la gtor rnying med pa'i zor gtor rnams drag po'i bshos bu zor chas can du bsgyur nas gtor bsham grwa tshang la bka' bkod mdzad de/ dam pa de nyid rang gi gzigs snang dang bstun zor kha nub tu bsgyur bar mdzad pa yin la/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku thog la dus mdos zhag bzhir gsung chog tshar gnyis re mdzad/ dus phyis 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi sku thog la zhag bdun 'phar ma'i phyag deb rje de nyid kyis mdzad pa las/ oṃ swasti/ bla ma rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'dir rnam rgyal zhes pa chu mo sbrul lor dus mdos chen mo sngar nas zhag bzhi re'i rgyun 'dug pa/ zhag bdun du spar ba'i cho ga sogs bya tshul gyi sgrig rim la/ nyer gnyis kyi nyin bca' ho sbyar/ zhes dang / der mi gsal ba sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag deb tu zhal 'phang mdzad pa ni/ sngags 'chang gi phyag deb de nyid las/ spyir mchod pa rnams kyi bsham mdun bskyed maṇḍal sgrub mchod kyi phyir/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i zhing khams sogs bkram pa dang /

'chams mgon rnams kyi mdun du stegs bang rim mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba dang / gtor ma rnams kyi mdun gtor gur rnams mdzes par bkram/ zhes dang / de nas gdan sa mdzod chen dang / bla brang nang nas phud phye dkar rgyan gtong rim rnams gsungs 'dug kyang / dus phyis phud phye dkar dmar gyi rgyan me tog nas bcas gnyer tshang gzhung nas gtong tho zur gsal nged rang nas bkod pa bzhin la/ gtor bzhengs dang bsham rnams grub pa dang / yang sngags 'chang phyag deb las/ ban tshang dpon dbyangs dpon dang bcas pas rnga sil/ rkang gling / dung / dar sa dngul dam phor/ spos phor sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la/ 'cham sku rnams spyan 'dren byas/ mchod gtor gyi drung du bzhugs grub nas/ zhes mdor bsdus las ma gsungs pas de'i gsal byed ni/ deng sang mgo zla'i nyer gnyis la/ a mes zhabs kyi lda ldi drag yol zhing chung ka ba rnams kyi khrab rmog rkang bzhi gos 'bag lh+wam bcas kyi khrab rmog rnams bsham/ nyer gsum la rje btsun ma kun dga' chos kyi nyi ma'i dgongs rdzogs tshogs chen gyi cho ga zhig yong bas/ der bsnyen song rnams tshogs/ ban tshang pa phyed bgos byas nas nyer gsum dus gtor dang / nyer lnga'i gur drag nam zi ma tshugs/ nyi rtse la 'cham sku do dam pa dang / khyad 'phags lho byang gi sku gnyer/ gyon mi babs kyis 'cham sku rnams/ tshoms chen gyi khri'i g.yas su zhal shar gzigs dang / byang gzigs su bsgrigs/ nyi ma shar lho nas cho ga'i gung gseng la bsnyen song rnams byang du byon nas zhwa gzan sogs gzab spros rnga rol sogs gra 'grigs pa dang bstun/ kun dga' rwa chung du rol mo ba lho dang / rnga pa byang du gral bsgrigs/ rol mo pa'i g.yas mthar chos dung / de g.yas dkyus zhwa med pa'i rkang gling pa gnyis/ rgyal sgo dang nye bar skya bo mdung pa gser skyems pa/ dung rgya gling ljags dung pa rnams 'khod grub pa dang /

bcom dung btang la bcom rol sum brdeg lan can 'phar ma'i chem brdung la rkang gling g.yab dar/ bcom rol grub nas mdung pa sogs sngon la btang / rnga rol rnams gral bsgrigs nas/ rgyal thod gung du byon te/ chos sde lho nas 'khar rnga phye 'phur/ 'cham sku'i phyag phyi ba sogs slebs pa dang / bcom dung bcom rol/ rkang gling sogs so ring bzhin/ dbyangs ring thung rol mo bcas chos nyid ngang las sogs/ mchod pa'i gnas 'dir dang / bzhugs nas dgra bgegs sogs la tshig rol/ gang gi rang bzhin sogs/ dur khrod bdag po sogs/ che zheng che mo sogs/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i sogs/ rgyun bzhin thur la tshig rol chem brdung rkang gling bcas dang / byon skyems chem rdung gi mjug tu gsum brdeg lan can rol skor chig rdung du bsgyur rjes thog mar mdung pa bzhi gral bsgrigs/ de nas skya bo dpon/ dung chen pa/ ljags dung pa/ phye phur ba/ rkang gling pa/ chos dung / 'khar rnga ba rnams nyis gshibs/ de nas brgya dpon dbu byed che ba/ rnga dpon dang byings gras gsum/ yang rol sil gnyis/ de nas rim pa ltar rnga rol rnams rgan gzhon gyi gral rim bsgrigs pa'i rnga rol ba gang yod thog ma nas brtsis/ rnga ji tsam gyi mtshams su rol tshil gang thob lhus thing par byas byon na legs pas/ thog mar rnga rol bsgrig skabs rnga rol gtso bo rnams dbus nas zur thon du 'byon dgos pa sogs gral bkod tshang ma grwa tshang mchod dpon pas byed/ rnga rol rdzogs nas nang rengs pa sogs 'bag pa rnams spungs/ spos phor ba gnyis/ rgya gling pa gser skyems pa rnams nyis gshibs/ de nas 'cham sku rnams da lta bzhin sa skya tshogs su rnga rol tshang ma byang nas lhor gral ring gcig bsgrigs pa'i rgyab tu sngon 'gros pa rnams bsgrigs/ gser skyems theng gsum gtor nas rol mo bzhi brdung bsgyur ba dang rkang grangs med pa'i 'cham dang 'cham sku'i sku 'chams ci rigs mdzad nas gral rim sngar bzhin gyi bzhi thog tu byon/

rnga rol sgrig tshul ni gong gi gral des shugs la grub bo/ /kun rwar 'cham sku 'khor bcas kyi sku 'cham ci rigs pa mdzad tshar ba dang / rol mo gsum brdeg lan can rol skor 'beb bcas byas la 'cham sku rnga rol bcas tshoms chen du bsdu/ 'cham sku rnams nged rang gi khri'i g.yon/ gtor khri'i g.yas dang / rgyab tu zhal shar dang lhor bstan la bsgrigs/ de 'phral tshogs dung dkar po rgyang grags gzim chung rtse sogs nas btang / dpon slob tshang ma tshogs tshar ba dang spyi mchod pas phyag gsum btsal te/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la byin brlabs gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li sogs kyai rdor bzhin gnas yo byin rlabs dang / de nas spyi mchod pas zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad dang rdo rje slob dpon gyis maṇḍal 'bul ba dang / rim pa gnyis kyi thugs dam la mnyam par 'jog pa zhu sogs slob dpon gyis brjod pa rnams kyai rdor sgrub mchod bzhin dang / mchod rol thams cad la rol dpon dang dung mkhan langs nas dkrol 'bud dang / dri med yid 'ong ma'i mchod rol la dkar mo rgyang grags gung gral gyi gsham nas tshogs dpon la bltas te 'bud pa'i phyag len 'dug cing / skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar lam dus rgyas pa bzhin/ tshogs dpon la zhal ngo byon nas bdag bskyed kyi ring dbu zhwa rnams srol 'dug kyang / slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa byin rlabs mdzad par zhu zhes dang / rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor ba sogs mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ yang slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed bsgrub par zhu zhes dang / mdun gyi ras bris zhing khams la dmigs la/ a mṛ tas bsangs ba nas/ ḍombhi ni la 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan zhes pa'i bar maṇḍal sgrub mchod bzhin brjod/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs gong du tshar ba yin pas/

dri med yid du 'ong ba sogs phyi mchod dang gos zung gi 'don cha shur ma/ nang mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma/ gnyis la dril gsil rol chen/ bstod pa nyi shu par gdangs dril gsil rnams mdzad tshar ba dang / phyi mchod pas phyag gsum btsal nas/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs mdzad de 'bul bar zhu/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ deng sang phyag len du mdzad pa ni/ kyai rdor mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i gtor bsngo bde mchog sogs gtor bsngo chen mo bzhin la spyan 'dren dril gsil rkang gling dang bstun/ dung chen dang rdza dung 'bud/ bzlas pa dang bcas pa rgyun bskang lugs/ bshags pa tshar gsum bzhugs nas mdzad de gung gseng / bskang ba thugs dam ma shur ma sor bzhag la dus mdos kyi ring dpal gyi bstan skyong ma 'dur ma mdzad pa de btsugs dus kyi rgyun de las sam snyam/ dkar chung shar ma gcig sa skya'i rje btsun ma bdun gyi rjes mar dbyangs 'di dang nyer dgu la bskang gsar gyi bzlog pa'ang spel ba/ bstod pa dbyangs res tshugs pa dang snga thog nas slob dpon zor las pa bcas bzlas pa tshugs pa'i phyag len de sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag deb bzhin mdzad srol 'dug kyang / de skabs sor bzhag rang deng sang cung ma byung 'dra ste/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdos chen pa dpon slob la gnang ba'i bka' shog las/ bstod pa tshugs nas chog dpon zor las pa dang bcas pas 'khon bcugs sbyang ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas yi ge brgya pa brgya lhag tsam dang / de nas tshogs dpon dang mgon po'i gtor las pas yi ge bdun ma gtso bo dang / gzhan gtor las pa so sos rang rang gi sngags rnams gtso bo dang / gzhan rnams kyang phreng 'khor re tsam tshang 'grig re bzla ba yig brgya nas phur srung gi sngags kyi bar gtor bsngos kyi bzlas pa'i skabs sgra ji bzhin dmigs pa rje rdo rje 'chang gi man ngag g.yul las rnam rgyal gyi drag po'i skabs de byed cing /

tshogs chen gyi 'ur rgyags ngos dkar mo ba'i bstod dbyangs tshugs su nye ba dang / tshogs dpon dang / zor las pa rnams mig lta bsgrigs nas spyir oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sogs sngags gsum la dril bu chig brdung dang / de nas dril bu bcad btub dang bcas sangs rgyas bstan srung ma'i las mkhan gyi bstod pa bsdus pa grub pa yan dril gsil dang bcas byed cing dkar mo ba man tshogs pa byings dang bstun nas byed ces dang / yang de nyid las bstod pa'i bar las gtor las pa so sos bzlas pa byed lugs/ zhal gyi des zhal bzhi pa'i sngags ring thung gang rigs/ pu tra'i des las mkhan gyi bod rbad bsad gsum/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ba des shā sa na gtso bo dang / lha mo'i sngags ring gang rigs/ bdud rgyal gyi des dkar bdud kyi sngags gnyis gtso bor bzla ba yin zhes sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rgyun 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi gsung las thos pa lags pas kun gyi thugs la 'jog par zhu/ zhes gsung kyang da lta phyag len la/ sngags dbyangs 'ur 'don/ mgon chen gyi bstod dbyangs dang po de slob dpon dang ban gtsang dbu byed gsum/ bde gling dbu byed bcas kyis mdzad nas bzlas pa tshugs/ nyer gsum nas nyer bdun gyi bar la dkar mo ba'i bstod dbyangs tshugs pa dang / slob dpon zor las pa rnams kyis bzlas pa bsdu/ sngags dbyangs gong du song ba des go chod pa'i dbang du btang nas/ sangs rgyas bstan srung ma bsdus pa/ phur srung bstod pa'i bar dril gsil mdzad/ byings dang mnyam du bstod pa'i mjug gi 'phrin bcol 'don pa las gzhan 'don srol mi 'dug cing / nyer brgyad la bdud rta bra nag dbyangs res tshugs pa dang dril gsil mdzad pa zhig 'dug pas/ da nas bzung 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi gsungs dang mthun par/ sngags dbyangs tshugs pa dang slob dpon zor las pa'i bzlas pa tshugs/ nyer gsum nas nyer drug gi bar la rab brjid dpa' ba'i dbyangs tshugs pa dang dril gsil gyi 'gor gur gyi yi ge bcu gnyis ma/

lha mo'i ro ru/ zhal gyi sngags thung rnams brjod nas/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba po nas/ bstan srung 'khor dang bcas la bstod par brjod la bzhag gzhan gyi 'don pa ma rdzogs na cung zad bsgugs la/ dkar bstod nas mnyam 'don byed/ nyer bdun la mon bu bha tra nag po ni/ zhes dbyangs res tshugs pa dang dril gsil/ nyer brgyad la bdud rta bra nag tshugs pa dang dril gsil/ nyer dgu la dbyangs res med pa'i dbang du btang zhing bstod pa thung stabs bzlas pa byed ring chog pa'ang mi 'dug cing gtor bsngo'i skabs su song bas chad skyon du'ang mi 'gro bas dpon slob kun mnyam 'don byas nas bzlas pa dang dril gsil ma mdzad na a mes zhabs kyi dgongs pa dang mthun pas de bzhin mdzod/ zhes 'phros don du bkod nas gong gi 'phros nyer gsum la sangs rgyas bstan srung ma'i tshig gnyis kyi dbyangs res gtso bo la bab/ kha dog nag cing sogs tshig gnyis la dbyangs ring / smin ma bsdus shing la mi 'gyur ma'i dbyangs bcug pa gung g.yas/ zhal ni mche ba/ dpa' bo stag lpags/ 'khor ba'i mtsho las rnams gur g.yon mgo phreng bzang po/ gang zhig legs par sogs rgyab g.yon/ sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig byed pa'i/ skye bo la ni rnam sdang zhing sogs rgyab g.yas/ dpal ldan lha mo shlau ka gcig la dbyangs 'khor gnyis rgyab g.yas/ de man la gzhan yang ma 'bring po bcug nas/ nam gru khyod kyi/ khyod kyi gdong yang sogs gung g.yas/ khyod kyi pha ni/ sum cu rtsa gsum sogs rgyab g.yon/ dpal ldan srid gsum ma dang po gtso dbyangs/ mchu 'phyangs shugs che mi mgo rlon pa/ gtor ma long la/ mtshon chas bsnun cing sogs gung g.yas/ dpa' bo mi mgo 'jigs rung gri gug sngon gyi zhal bzhes sogs gung g.yon/ ti se'i gangs dang / sha chen zan gyi/ myur du bsad cing / rtse gcig dad pa'i sogs rgyab g.yon/ se skyar khyod ni/ phyogs bcu kun dang /

g.yung mo/ gtum mo sogs rgyab g.yas so/ de dag gi sdom ni/ so sor tshig babs dang po'i rim 'dis shes/ /dbyangs res gral rim tshigs bcad 'di nyid ded/ /sangs bstan dbyangs ring gtso dbyangs gung g.yas dang / /dbyangs thung gung g.yon gnyis dang gung g.yas gcig /rgyab g.yon rgyab g.yas gung g.yon rgyab g.yon no/ /gsum brdeb rdzogs nas rol mo gcig lhag pa'i/ /nyis brdeg 'phar bcas lha mo'i bstod pa la/ /dbyangs ring tsho gnyis rgyab g.yas de phyin chad/ /gzhan yang 'bring bcug dbyangs gnyis gung g.yas pa/ /dbyangs 'khor gnyis ni rgyab g.yon byas nas su/ /'dzam bu gling man 'ur shar zhal bstod la/ /tshig rkang dang gnyis gtso dbyangs gnyis gung g.yas/ /dbyangs 'khor gnyis ni gung g.yon gcig gung g.yas/ /rgyab g.yon rgyab g.yas gung g.yon rgyab g.yon te/ /rgyab g.yas gnyis dang gung g.yas gnyis dang ni/ /rgyab g.yon gnyis rjes dpal ldan brgyad nas shar/ /'di rnams dus mdos nyer gsum dbyangs res yin/ /gsum brdeg nyis brdung bsgyur sogs rol mo yi/ /gong du gcig lhag rol mo'i rnam gzhag 'di/ /'og nas byung ba'i rol bsgyur kun la 'gre/ /rab brjid ma la mon bu pu tra'i dbyangs/ /dkar bstod la dus mdos ma grub bar dpal thugs sha stag mdzad/ 'phrin bcol gyi mjug tu gsum brdeg lan can byas la bzhag mol la ba langs mtshams bstod pa'i dbyangs res ring thung la dpag nas dbyangs res bzhi lnga ma rdzogs tsam la langs pas snga phyi ran pa yong zhes a mes zhabs kyi bka' shog las gsungs/ bstod pa 'phrin bcol bcas grub pa dang / spyi mchod pas phyag gsum btsal te/ tshogs kyi yo byad la byin rlabs gnang bar zhu zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis tshogs nang mchod ltar byin brlabs mdzad nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes brjod/ yang spyi mchod pas thod pa padma bhañdza la sogs pa'i snod du ma da na'i phud cung zad blugs pa gtor ma dang rten gyi mdun du bzhag la/

bla ma dang dkon mchog gi spyan sngar ma da na'i phud 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing sogs dang / sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas sogs brjod/ yang spyi mchod pas phyag gsum btsal la tshogs kyi phud phul zhing / bla ma dang dkon mchog gi spyan sngar tshogs kyi phud 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan zhing sogs shlau ka gcig brjod/ yang spyi mchod pas mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i spyan sngar tshogs kyi phud 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis kyai rdor gyi gtor sngags nas brtsams te dkar bdud/ phur srung gi bar/ yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor sngags tshar re brjod/ de nas spyi mchod pas padma bhañdza la sogs pa'i snod ji ltar rigs par ma da na dang ba la cung zad khyer la rdo rje slob dpon gyi drung du bzhag ste phyag gsum btsal la/ lag pa g.yas kyis ma da na bzung / g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ba la cung zad re bzung la/ ma da na'i steng du g.yon pas pad skor bya zhing rjes su steng nas cung zad bkag la dbul zhing / ngag tu/ 'di ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa yang / /rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du zo/ /a ho su kha/ zhes dang / slob dpon gyis kyang pad skor bya zhing / bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang / mtheb srin gnyis kyis ba la dang / ma da na cung zad blangs la lcer myang zhing / a ho su kha/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du tshogs pa thams cad kyi drung du/ 'di ni chos rnams sogs gong bzhin dang / tshogs pa rnams kyis kyang / bde gshegs chos la sogs brjod cing lcer myong tshul bya/ de nas mol bas mol gtam gyis brda' sprod pa dang /

spyi mchod pas tshogs kyi lhag ma rnams snod du blugs la/ ma da nas bran te phyag gsum btsal te/ lhag ma'i gtor ma la byin brlabs gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis yi ge brgya pa dang 'bru gsum dang / a kā ro'i sngags brjod cing byin gyis brlabs/ de nas spyi mchod pas lhag ma de dang ma da na cung zad khyer te slob dpon gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis ma da na cung zad khar 'thung tshul dang / lag pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas pa'i ngang nas lhag ma la kha phru btab tshul/ ngag tu pheṃ zhes dang / oṃ u tsiṣṭha ba liṃ ta bhakṣa si swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum dang lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams tshim par gyur cig ces brjod cing / lhag ma spyi mchod pas phyi rol du dor/ dpon slob rnams kyis dril bu gsil zhing / rdo rje'i glu bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad/ rigs su skye dang sogs brjod/ de nas/ sbyin bdag gi don du slob dpon gyis mchod bsngo sogs skabs thob dang bstun la rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa byas la/ rjes chog gi mchod pa byin rlabs dang / sngags tsam gyis phyi mchod/ rol chen/ nang mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis yid mchod dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs bstod pa gnyis la rol chen/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ med pa rnams gshegs gsol/ skye mched sku gsung thugs bsrung bsngo smon bkra shis rnams kyai rdor dkyil chog bzhin la/ nyer gsum nas nyer brgyad kyi bar chos srung nor lha'i bkra shis bsdus pa rgyun bskang bzhin grol dung la rdza dung thengs gsum tsam 'bud pa las dung chen 'bud srol med/ mthil chos khrims pas/ phyag gsum phul nas dung snga phyi'i brda' gtong / thun gtor ban gtsang ba rnams kyis steng du 'bul/ nyer gsum nas nyer drug gi bar gyi gtor 'bul thams cad la sngags dbyangs nas/

spyi btab 'phrin 'chol bcas rdzogs pa'i bar bde gling dgu gtor bzhin la srid zhi dpal 'byor ma sogs mi mdzad/ dkar dung dang dung chen sogs med cing rol mo gcig gis chog gnas khang gang 'os su nged rang dang ban tshang pa gang yod/ bde gling dbu byed rnams tshogs thog mdzod nas ja re dang phu zhu a rag sogs bsgrigs mgron 'gag 'dren spyi mchod pa sogs kyis bteg la/ sang nyin gyi gtso dbyangs bsgrigs chags mdzad pas/ nyer gsum dgong srin gzugs ma/ de ltar tshar gcod ma/ dpal ldan dbang ldan ma rnams mdzad nas grwa tshang mchod dpon gyis chab btang la gyes/ ༈ /nyer bzhi la tshogs dung nas gnas yo byin brlabs kyi bar 'dra/ de nas spyi mchod pas chu sbyin bshams la/ phyag gsum btsal te/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bskyed chog gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed thun mong du sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sogs gsil gtor brgya rtsa bzhin byas la/ ma ṇi 'phreng 'khor tsam 'ur 'don/ mchod bstod 'dod gsol la slob dpon gyis ting shag dkrol/ yang spyi mchod pas chu sbyin gyi kha gsos/ spyan ras gzigs kyi chu sbyin gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis/ spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal ba'i gtsug tor can/ /zhes sogs nas/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ bar brjod/ phyi mchod pas gtor snod kyi phyi rol du chu thigs pa gcig blugs cing / tog gcig ma la chab thal zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis se gol gtogs cing / āḥhrīḥzhes sogs nas/ bsil bar shog bar brjod/ yang spyi mchod pas chu sbyin kha gso zhing / mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i chu sbyin gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i rgyal po la/ zhes sogs nas/ gyur cig gi bar brjod/

yang spyi mchod pas chu kha gsos te/ ye shes skar mda'i chu sbyin gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis oṃ dzñā na zhes sogs nas/ gyur cig gi bar brjod/ yang spyi mchod pas dzam gtor la chab bran zhing / dzam bha la ser po'i bskyed chog gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis/ a mṛ tas bsangs ba sogs brgya rtsa bzhin/ dbur brgyan gyi bar mdzad/ spyi mchod pas dzambha la'i sku yod na de'i dbu dang / med na gtor theb gtsang mar chu blugs cing dzambha la'i dbu la phul bar mos la dzam chu 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis/ mchog sbyin se gol gtogs cing / bhrūm̐ aṃ sogs rigs lnga'i sa bon tshar gcig dang dzam sngags lan bdun brjod/ yang spyi mchod pas dzam bshos 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis gtor ma byin brlabs nas/ sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzod bar brgya rtsa bzhin brjod/ yang spyi mchod pas dzam nag gtor mar chu bran la/ dzam bha la nag po'i bskyed chog gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis/ dzam nag bskyed chog dbur rgyan gyi bar brgya rtsa bzhin brjod/ spyi mchod pas chu blug cing / dzam chu 'bul bar zhu zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis oṃ ind+ra ni sogs tshar gcig dang / oṃ dzam luṃ sogs bdun/ mchog sbyin se gol bcas kyis dzam nag chu sbyin/ spyi mchod pas dzam bshos 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis gtor ma byin brlab nas bzung / rtag tu yid la re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod bar brgya rtsa bzhin/ spyi mchod pas dzam chu gnyis snod gcig tu bsdus/ slob dpon la phul ba dang / slob dpon gyis myangs shing / bdag dang sems can thams cad nas/ pha la ho bar brgya rtsa bzhin brjod/ spyi mchod pas dkar cha bzhin sbyangs la/ dkar cha bzhi gzhi bdag gtor ma dang bcas pa la chab thal/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs mdzad de 'bul bar zhu zhes dang /

dpon slob rnams kyis/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs dkar cha bzhi rgyun bzhin la/ 'khon 'gras med par mdzod kyi rjes su/ na mo bdag gis bsam pa'i stobs dang sogs 'thud la 'dren par shog bar/ bzhes thug mchod/ dkar cha bzhi ring la spyi mchod pas zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad las tshogs par me tog bsdu ba'i bar bya/ bzhes thug grub pa dang thun mong du maṇḍal 'bul zhing slob dpon gyis thugs dam mdzad par bskul ba/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ gtor bsngo'i bzlas bsham gyi phrin 'chol bar gong bzhin chab btang nas bzhengs la/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥsogs/ phyag 'tshal bshags pa gsum/ khyed thugs ma gdangs ring rnams dgu gtor chen mo'i nyer brgyad bzhin/ gung gseng / bskang rdzas byin brlabs grub nas bcom rol chos nyid ma bzhin la chem brdung rjes ma rdzogs nas nyis brdeg las che gcig mi dgos nag po mchod rten gyi spyan 'dren shlau ka gcig la srin thung / ma hā kā la gshegs su gsol la tshig rol chos nyid ma'i spyan 'dren dbyangs rol/ gong gi rang bzhin sogs thugs dam ma shur ma bzhin la spyan 'dren dang byon skyems kyi chem brdung gnyis ka'i rjes su gsum brdeg lan can byon skyems la de'i rjes su rol skor 'bebs bcas/ 'bul sngags 'phrin 'chol rgyun bzhin/ nag po mchod rten gsum la dbyangs rol nyer lnga lugs/ chos nyid ma'i dbyangs rol yongs rdzogs/ gzhan yang ma dang lha mchog ma gnyis shur ma gsum re/ chab gung gseng / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi sogs/ chos dbyings spros bral ma gsum/ bde chen lhun grub ma gcig nag po gnod sbyin ma shur ma lnga/ bdud dpung kun 'joms ma gcig dpal gyi bstan skyong ma gcig dkar chung shur ma gsum/ gtum chen ma dang sku dang gsung thugs ma gnyis bdun re la dbyangs rol med/ rtsa brgyud bla ma gcig bse khrab pa'i bskang gso rnams mdzad nas gsol bar gyis/

dgong dung btang nas 'dus la sa skya'i rje btsun ma bdun gyi rjes mar dbyangs/ nag po mchod rten gyi 'phrin 'chol/ nag po mchod rten gyi bzlog pa gsum gyi rol mo gong 'og gnyis la thugs dam pa mgo dbyangs lugs dang / bar mar shur ma lugs/ bskang gsar bzlog pa mi dgos/ bshags pa bka' bsgo chos nyid ma'i 'phrin 'chol/ bzlog pa bshags pa rnams byas la/ slob dpon dang zor las pas bzlas pa tshugs/ gzhan rnams kyis sngags dbyangs dang srin gzugs ma'i shlau ka gcig gtso dbyangs dbyangs ring mdog nag gzugs thung dang / dbyangs thung legs ldan nag po tshig lnga gung g.yas/ dbyangs ring khros pa'i zhabs brdabs dang / dbyangs thung dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la ye tshig lnga/ bdud dang dam tshig rkang gnyis dang / bla mas bcol pa'i sogs gung g.yon/'dir gshegs shlau ka gcig rgyab g.yon/ sngar bcol legs pa dang / dpon slob srung zhing sogs tshig rkang gnyis rgyab g.yas/ gang gi sku gsung / mi ro khar bcug 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha rgyab g.yon/ 'dod pa'i khams la/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs rgyab g.yas/ dbang po sngon po/ dbu skra dmar ser sogs gung g.yas/ de ltar tshar gcod gtso dbyangs/ khyed la gus pas/ thams cad bu bzhin/ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ gang yang bdag cag sogs gung g.yas/ khyod kyi dang po/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa yid bzhin du ni sogs gung g.yon/ dam tshig 'di las/ bstan la gnod pa/ khyed kyi zhal nas/ tshe dang bsod nams sogs rgyab g.yon/ bde gshegs bstan pa/ gdug cing sdang sems/ dpung dang bcas pa'i tshogs/ rgyab g.yas/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs rgyab g.yas kyi tshugs pa dang / rol dpon sil snyan gcig gung gral/ g.yas kyi dbyangs dpon rnams ma gtogs dbyings gung gseng / mu nas gung gseng ma grub pa rnams la rim bzhin gung gseng / dpal dbang ma dang gtso dbyangs dbyangs ring sgra sgrogs dril bu/ 'jigs byed myur 'gro sogs dang /

dbyangs thung khyed kyi rang phyogs/ de ltar bstod pa'i sogs gung g.yas/ dbyangs ring du ma'i ming can/ brkyang bskum glog stong sogs dang / dbyangs thung ha ha'i gad rgyangs sogs gung g.yon/ dbyangs ring kṣiṃ kṣiṃ sogs dang / dbyangs thung rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ khyed kyis sgrub pa'i/ klog pa rnams ni sogs rgyab g.yon/ dpal ldan gru 'dzin/ sha chen zan dang / g.yung mo gtum mo sogs rgyab g.yas te tshig babs rnams dang / gral sdom ni/ srin gzugs dbyangs ring gtso dbyangs gung g.yas dang / /gung g.yon gcig dang srin thung tshig rkang lngar/ /bcug pa'ang gung g.yon slar yang tshig rkang lnga/ /gung g.yas 'dir gshegs rgyab g.yon rgyab g.yas dang / /gung g.yon gyis dbyangs gsum brdeg 'phar mar bsgyur/ /gang sku rgyab g.yon gcig dang rgyab g.yas gnyis/ /gung g.yas gnyis dang rgyab g.yon gnyis rnams so/ /klu dbang nas shar bu dbyangs dang po gtso/ /gung g.yas gcig dang gung g.yon gnyis dang ni/ /gung g.yas rgyab g.yon rgyab g.yas gung g.yon re/ /rgyab g.yon gcig dang rgyab g.yas gnyis dang ni/ /gung g.yas gnyis dang rgyab g.yon gnyis rnams so/ /'gro kun nas shar dpal dbang dang po gtso/ /gung g.yas gcig dang gung g.yon gnyis dang ni/ /gung g.yas rgyab g.yon rnams kyis re byas la/ /rol mo gsum brdeg 'phar med du bsgyur nas/ /dpal ldan gru 'dzin rgyab g.yas gung g.yon re/ /rgyab g.yon gcig dang rgyab g.yas gnyis dang ni/ /gung g.yas gnyis dang rgyab g.yon gnyis rnams so/ /mdor na gang dang man chad 'ur shar te/ /'di rnams dus mdos nyer bzhi'i dbyangs rol yin/ /de ltar 'ur shar nas bkra shis kyi bar gong bzhin/ /gtor 'bul gung pa'i dbyangs dpon rgyab gral g.yas pas byed/ /dbyangs char sngon tshe rgya klong stong nyid ma rnams so/ ༈ /nyer lnga la tshogs dung nas sngags dbyangs kyi bar nyer bzhi bzhin/ sngon tshe ma dang po gtso dbyangs/

mgon po'i bka' nyan/ sngon tshe bde gshegs sogs gung g.yas/ bstan la rab dga'/ rgyu ma mi mgo sogs gung g.yon rnams dbyangs ring yin/ 'dir gshegs man chad dbyangs thung nyer bzhi bzhin/ til mar gyis bkus/ ske rags 'chings shing / ko rlon chen po sogs rgyab g.yon/ gcer bu bong bu/ 'khor ba 'jig pa'i sogs rgyab g.yas/ nag mo mi thod/ khyed ni dpal bo sogs gung g.yas/ rgya klong ma 'ur rgyag rgyab gral g.yas kyi dbyangs res tshugs pa dang gung gseng gdong bzhin/ stong nyid ma dang po gtso dbyangs/ dbyangs ring dpal ldan khrag 'thung dang / phyogs bcu kun tu sogs dbyangs thung / 'dir byon bdag la dang / sman raka phud sogs gung g.yas/ dbyangs ring srid gsum dbang bsgyur/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs/ sgrub la dngos grub sogs gung g.yon/ dbyangs ring bsil ba'i tshal dang khyed kyi sring mo sogs/ dbyangs thung bde gshegs bstan pa dang / dur khrod sha zar mi 'gyur ma bcug pa rgyab g.yon/ dbyangs ring sna tshogs zhal dang khyed thugs dges pa sogs/ dbyangs thung lha mchog nag po rgyab g.yas te/ tshig babs rnams dang / gral sdom ni/ sngon tshe dbyangs ring gtso dbyangs gung g.yas dang / /gung g.yon gnyis dang gung g.yas gcig byas la/ /'dir gshegs man chad dbyangs res nyer bzhi bzhin/ /'then rkang 'phar rol gnyis dang 'phar med kyis/ /gsum brdeg che gcig byas la til mar ma/ /rgyab g.yon gcig dang rgyab g.yas gnyis dang ni/ /gung g.yas gnyis dang rgyab g.yon gnyis byas la/ /lus ni snum gyi man chad 'ur shar dang / /rgya klong 'ur rgyags stong nyid dang po gtso/ /gung g.yas gcig dang gung g.yon gnyis dang ni/ /gung g.yas rgyab g.yon rgyab g.yas gung g.yon dang / /rgyab g.yon rgyab g.yas rnams kyi dbyangs ring rjes/ /rol ring rdzogs nas gsum brdeg 'phar med bsgyur/ /lha mchog nag po rgyab g.yas gcig dang ni/ /gung g.yas gnyis dang rgyab g.yon gcig byas la/

/dur khrod sha zar mi 'gyur rgyab g.yon pa/ /ma hā kā la nas bzung 'ur shar de/ /'di rnams dus mchod nyer lnga'i dbyangs res yin/ /de man gong bzhin gtor 'bul spyi mchod pa/ dbyangs chags/ gang thugs/ mi pham/ skad dung sgra/ ma bhyoḥ 'dir gshegs paṃ padma rnams so/ ༈ /nyer drug la gzhan gong bzhin la/ chos nyid ma med pas bskang gso'i bcom rol thugs dam ma lugs/ spyan 'dren byon skyems gnyis ka'i chem brdung rjes su gsum brdeg lan can med/ bskang gso'i dbyangs rol grangs gsog bcas gong bzhin la dkar chung rdzogs nas gung gseng / nag po mchod rten gyi bshags pa lnga/ gang thugs ma dang po gtso dbyangs/ dbyangs ring khyod sku lhun po/ ā li kā li sogs dbyangs thung lha dang mi dang / gang zhig zhi bas sogs gung g.yas/ dbyangs ring skyon drug gcod phyir/ chos grwa chen po/ thugs bstod tshig rkang drug rnams gung g.yon/ dbyangs ring rin chen pa sogs/ dbyangs thung dpa' bo khyed kyis rnal 'byor rdo rje 'dzin pa/ bskrad gzir bcings shing sogs rgyab g.yon/ dbyangs ring gsung bstod tshig rkang drug dbyangs thung bdag cag 'khor dang / bdag cag rnams la sogs rgyab g.yas mi pham ma dang po gtso dbyangs/ dbyangs ring snying rje'i dbang gis/ ral pa gyen bsgrengs/ shakta'i ral gri/ glang po che yi ko rlon sogs/ dbyangs thung lho phyogs gshin rje'i/ sum cu rtsa gsum/ nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sogs gung g.yas/ dbyangs ring lha mo nag mo/ shin tu rid cing / snyan g.yas sbrul gyis sogs/ dbyangs thung ting 'dzin dbang thob/ gzhan la dbang bsgyur/ rgyal chen bzhi sogs gung g.yon/ dbyangs ring rna ltag me tog snyan rgyan g.yon pa/ phye tsam re lde/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgrogs sogs/ dbyangs thung lha ma yin rnams/ sa 'og dbang po/ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bdud rtsi sogs rgyab g.yon/

dbyangs ring mi ro rengs pa/ phyag gzhi'i g.yas kyis/ g.yon gyi dang po sogs/ dbyangs thung sku mchog ri rab/ bdud dang gshin rje/ dam sri'i tshogs rnams sogs rgyab g.yas/ ma bhyoḥ 'dir gshegs 'ur rgyag rgyab gral g.yas kyi phyag bzhi g.yas kyi sogs tshugs pa dang gung gseng gong bzhin/ paṃ pad dang po gtso dbyangs/ g.yas gnyis sngon po/ g.yas g.yon 'og ma/ gtso bo 'khor bcas/ sha chen sran chen sogs gung g.yas/ g.yon gnyis ljang khu g.yas g.yon gri gug las mkhan 'khor gyi sogs gung g.yon/ mi mgo khrag 'dzag g.yon nas rgyug byed sogs paṃ padma'i gras dang / dur khrod sha za/ ma hā kā la sogs la mi 'gyur ma bcug pa rgyab g.yon/ zhabs gnyis dor stabs/ mdun nas 'jigs gzugs/ rgyab nas gar stabs sogs rgyab g.yas te tshig babs dang / gral sdom ni/ gang thugs dbyangs ring gtso dbyangs gung g.yas dang / /gung g.yon gnyis dang gung g.yas rgyab g.yon gcig /gsol gong du byas 'dus nas gsung bstod ni/ /tshig drug dbyangs 'khor gcig rdzogs rgyab g.yas dang / /thugs bstod tshig drug gung g.yon dbyangs 'khor gcig /bu dbyangs dang po rgyab g.yon de rjes su/ /rgyab g.yas gnyis dang gung g.yas gnyis dang ni/ /rgyab g.yon gnyis byas skad cig man chad shar/ /mi pham dang po gtso dbyangs gung g.yas dang / /gung g.yas gnyis dang gung g.yon rgyab g.yon g.yas/ /gung g.yon rgyab g.yon re dang rgyab g.yas gnyis/ /gung g.yas gnyis dang rgyab g.yon gnyis byas nas/ /bong rmig nas shar bu dbyangs dang po gtso/ /gung g.yas gcig dang gung g.yon gnyis dang ni/ /gung g.yas rgyab g.yon rgyab g.yas gung g.yon dang / /rgyab g.yon rnams kyi re dang rgyab g.yas gnyis/ /gung g.yas gnyis dang rgyab g.yon gnyis byas nas/ /bdud rtsi'i rlangs pa nas shar 'dir gshegs ma/ /'ur rgyag paṃ pad dang po gtso dbyangs dang / /gung g.yas gcig dang gung g.yon gnyis dang ni/ /gung g.yas rgyab g.yon rgyab g.yas gung g.yon dang /

/rgyab g.yon rnams kyis re byas rgyab g.yas gnyis/ /gung g.yas gnyis byas rol mo nyis brdeg rjes/ /gsum brdeg 'phar med bsgyur nas rgyab g.yon pas/ /nor skyong gnod sbyin yab la mi 'gyur ma/ /de yi yum mchog man chad 'ur shar te/ /'di rnams dus mchod nyer drug dbyangs res yin/ /de man gong bzhin gtor 'bul ban tshang pa/ /dbyangs chag ma skyes mkha' klong dang khyed bzhugs ma'o/ ༈ /nyer bdun la sngags dbyangs bar nyer drug bzhin ma skyes mkha' klong dang po gtso dbyangs/ lhun gyis grub pa'i nyon mongs las kyi/ sbyin no bskul lo/ gzir zhing mnan bskrad sogs dang / khyed bzhugs ma'i gras khyod kyi sku ni/ rnam pa mang po'i sogs dang / gnod sbyin yab yum la mi 'gyur ma bcug pa gung g.yas/ dag gsal rtogs pas/ bstan la rab dga'/ 'phrin las sna tshogs sogs dang khyod bzhugs ma'i gras phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyis/ nag po chen po mche ba gtsigs pa'i/ sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po sogs gung g.yon yon tan rab rdzogs/ mnyam nyid mthar phyin sogs dang / rdo rje 'chang dbang ma dbyangs 'khor gnyis/ khyod bzhugs ma'i gras/ dpal ldan khyod kyi tshig lnga/ bla ma dam pa'i sogs pu tra dang / bha ṭa la mi 'gyur ma bcug pa rgyab g.yon zhe sdang ma spangs/ chos sku spros pa/ phyi nang gsang ba'i sogs dang / khyod bzhugs ma'i gras sha chen spos kyi sogs/ sod gcig sogs rol mo dzar bcas/ dur khrod sha za la mi 'gyur ma bcug pa rgyab g.yas te tshigs babs dang / gral sdom ni/ ma skyes mkha' klong dang po gtso dbyangs dang / /gung g.yas gcig dang gung g.yon gnyis dang ni/ /gung g.yas rgyab g.yon rgyab g.yas gung g.yon dang / /rgyab g.yon rnams kyis re byas rgyab g.yas gnyis/ /gung g.yas gnyis rjes rol mo gsum brdeg mthar/ /nyis brdeg 'phar ma byas la rgyab g.yon pas/ /spyan 'dren rdo rje 'chang dbang dbyangs 'khor gnyis/

/dkyil 'khor chen po nas shar khyed gtso bos/ /dbyangs 'khor gcig byas gsol bar gyes ran dang / /shar pa'am g.yas gral gtor 'bul brda' gtogs ni/ /mthil pa chos khrims pas byas de dang bstun/ /gtor 'bul dpon slob gzab spros bcas 'dus nas/ /gong 'phros gung g.yas gcig dang gung g.yon gnyis/ /gung g.yas rgyab g.yon rgyab g.yas gung g.yon dang / /rgyab g.yon rnams kyis re byas sod cig sogs/ /tshig rkang gsum la dbyangs rol rgyab g.yas pa/ /tshig rkang gcig la dzar bcas rgyab g.yas yin/ /dur khrod sha zar mi 'gyur rgyab g.yas pa/ /yab yum gnyis bstod dbyangs de gung g.yas pa/ /dbyangs 'dra pu tra bha ṭa rgyab g.yon no/ /de yi mched mo man chad 'ur shar ste/ /'di rnams dus mdos nyer bdun dbyangs res yin/ /de man gong bzhin chos gzhis shar nub kyi grwa mang nyung 'dra na/ shar pa dang mi snyoms na g.yas gral gtor 'bul la chos dung / rol mo gsum/ sil snyan gsum/ de 'phros lnga/ thog khar dar nag bzhi/ dung chen rdzag dung rnams bsgrigs nas mthil gang 'os su pu tra bskul rgyun bzhin byas nas/ gtor 'bul ba rnams steng du 'byon pa dang / thog mar gnod sbyin yab yum/ pu tra 'cham pa rnams dang / rnga rol rdzogs nas bha ṭa sring mo gnyis bcas 'thon la/ rol mo bcu bzhi brdeg gi rjes su nyis brdeg lan med pas rol bskor 'bebs bcas dang ja mchod bcom rol bcas mi dgos/ nam mkha' 'brug sgra dang / sgar dbyangs/ lcam dral khyed kyi man la srin thung / mkha' lding lce spyang sogs tshig rkang lnga la dbyangs skor cig rol mo ba rnams gtor ma phyogs su kha bltas kyis bdud dang ma'i rol mo gong bzhin/ bla mas bcol ba'i rjes kyi nyis brdeg gi rjes su 'then rkang gsum byas la gong bzhin kha bsgyur te chem brdung drag dung / yang chem brdung drag dung bcas gtor ma phul/ de phyin gyi rol dbyangs 'don cha bcas rgyun bzhin yin/

'di skabs gzigs mo bzhugs gral/ zhes rab gsal thog kha sogs gang 'os su nged rang dang / gtor 'bul med pa'i ban tshang dbu byed gang yod/ grwa tshang mchod dpon rnams la ja gral/ dpon yig dang mthil chos khrims pas gtor 'bul grwa tshogs kyi mtshan tho bcas byed srol 'dug kyang / gtor 'bul grub nas dbyangs chags la dril bu dam tshig shā sa na'i sngags dbyangs/ bhyoḥ 'dren bcas khro la rngam pa'i la gnod sbyin 'gying dbyangs/ 'jigs byed dbyangs las dang / nag mo bzang mo la su chen gyi dbyangs bcug nas/ nag mo bzang mo'i tshig tshig lhad sbrel mtshams su wā ya/ bhyoḥ'o wā wa ya zhes gsungs srol rnams so/ ༈ /nyer brgyad la tshogs dung nas/ gtor bsngo'i bzlas gsham gyi 'phrin 'chol bar gong bzhin byas la gung gseng / bdud rtsi lnga mchod la tshogs lcam gsar pa dang / ban gtsang pa sogs chos gos thob ris rnams kyis de bzhin gyon srol 'dug pas gung gseng 'dus skabs su gyon la/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥsogs phyag 'tshal bshags pa nas/ byon skyems chems brdung gi bar gong bzhin la/ de rjes gsum brdeg lan can rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ 'bul sngags mchod 'phrin rnams rdzogs nas bdud rtsi lnga mchod drug cu pa bzhin/ 'on kyang dbu byed des rnga chen dmigs bsal brdung / slob dpon gyi ḍā dril thogs la rol mo byung tshad la dkrol zhing / dril bu dam tshig gi dbyangs ma rdzogs bar la rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu chig brdung byas nas dbyangs kyi tshig lhad rnga yog phog mtshams kyi bar bzhag pa dang dril bu 'phro bcad/ yang bskul ba'i sgra bar dkrol/ de 'phros kyi tshig lhad dang / rnga chen sogs la dkrol mi dgos/ dung chen gling bu snyan pa'i sgra la rkang gling dung chen rdzag dung rnams 'bud srol 'dug cing / tshig 'di'i go don dngos ni/ dung chen gling bu zhes pa mi rus kyi rkang gling yin/

cang te'u 'phrin las sogs la cang te'u dngos dkrol lo/ /bdud rtsi lnga mchod rdzogs nas/ nag po mchod rten sngo dmar rdo rje brag chen dang / mi 'gyur ma la rol mo/ bar mar rnam dag tshogs gtor la rol mo/ rjes mar/ kye bso dbyangs rol las mgon po 'khor dang mar dbyangs med/ gzhan yang ma/ lha mchog ma/ nag po gnod sbyin/ dkar chung / gtum chen ma rnams la 'go dbyangs/ sku dang gsung thugs mar rol mo/ 'di rnams kyi grangs gsog gong bzhin yin/ rtsa brgyud bla ma man sngags dbyangs bar nyer bdun dang 'dra/ bshags pa rdzogs nas gsol bar gyes khar nub pa'am g.yon gral gtor 'bul gyi brda' gtong / dgong tshogs la sa skya'i rje btsun sogs gong 'phros/ nag rngam ma dang po gtso dbyangs/ bstan pa nye bar la nag rngam ma bcug pa dang / g.yung mo gtum mo/ dpal ldan dkar mo/ dpal chen bka' yi rnams la mi 'gyur ma bcug pa gung g.yas/ sha za mkha' 'gro dang dpal dbang ma la nag rngam ma bcug pa dang / de yi yum mchog mi 'gyur ma rnams gung g.yon dur khrod sha za/ rab brjid dpa' bo/ bdud rta bra nag slob dpon padma sogs la mi 'gyur ma rgyab g.yon/ ma hā kā la/ mon bu bha ṭa/ de yi mched mo rnams la mi 'gyur ma bcug pa rgyab g.yas te tshig babs dang / gral sdom ni/ nag rngam dang po gtso dbyangs gung g.yas dang / /sha za mkha' 'gro dpal ldan dbang ldan mar/ /dbyangs de bcug pa 'khor gnyis gung g.yon dang / /sring bzhi phur bsrung bar la mi 'gyur ma/ /bcugs te gung g.yas rgyab g.yon rgyab g.yas dang / /gung g.yon rgyab g.yon re dang rgyab g.yas gnyis/ /gung g.yas gnyis dang rgyab g.yon gnyis rnams so/ /rdo rje gur gyi man chad 'ur shar te/ /'di rnams dus mdos nyer brgyad dbyangs rol yin/ de man gong bzhin/ nub pa'i gtor 'bul gyi skor tshang ma shar ba bzhin/ dbyangs chags la hūm̐ ngo bhyo'o wā wā ya zhes sbyar la/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang /

dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud sogs kyi tshig la/ dbyangs nam mkha' 'brug sgra bcug pa/ drag bskul dus gsum rgyal ba ma'i gras/ gṛhna bandha shlau ka gcig la gang thugs ma'i bu dbyangs/ pho nya bskul gras steng gi pho nya'i dbyangs rnams byas nas zhwa gyon/ dpal mgon ma hā kā la sogs bkra shis 'chams dbyangs rnams so/ /phyag deb rnams la 'cham res pa rnams kyis 'chams byed gsungs pa de mthil pa rnams kyi phur pa'i rtsa 'chams bgyis skabs khrom zil gnon zhes drung 'khor gzab 'chor can sogs bskor g.yeng la 'gro srol dang bcas pa'i 'chams 'di snga thog rang nas phyag len la yod par mngon te/ dus mchod bla brang pa'i gdung brgyud bla chen bsod nams blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i mdos bskang las/ rgyas par spro na cho ga rnams tshar ba'i rjes mdos ma khyer ba'i gong du phur pa'i rtsa 'chams/ gshin rje'i zor 'chams la sogs pa gang mos byed ces sogs dang / mdos gzhung de nyid kyi bskul gyi skabs su'ang / bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la bskul mdzad pa sogs la/ tshar chen rin po ches dmar chen gtor bzlog gi yi ge las/ 'di na la la gsang sngags rnying ma ba'i/ /phur pa rta mgrin gshin rje la sogs dang / /phyag bzhi la sogs mthong thos chos skyong gi /man ngag gyis bslad 'gal 'dul 'phreng ba mthong / /zhes zur za mdzad mod/ mdos gong du phur pa'i 'chams bgyis pa la 'gal ba med de/ sa lo chen po'i 'chams bshad las/ rjes mjug tu lta ba chos nyid zab mo'i don rtogs shing / yi dam lha'i ting nge 'dzin las su rung ba'i sngags 'chang gis 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa la sogs pa dgos byed khyad par can gyi skabs su bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'chams bgyis pas sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs cing bkra shis pa dang / bar chad bzlog pa'i dgos pa yod pa lags/ zhes gsungs pas 'phrin las bzhi sgrub dus 'chams dgos par gsungs shing /

bsod blos zur bskul de'ang mi 'gal te/ tshar chen nyid kyi bzlog gzhung las/ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis/ /zor chen rdzas kyis zhes sogs gsungs pas/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi gras la bka' brgyad 'gro bar ma zad/ 'khon sa skya'i lhag lha yang phur dang rjes 'brel bka' brgyad bskul ba la 'gal ba gtan nas med do/ /'phros don no/ ༈ /nyer dgu la tshogs dung nam zi dang / gnas yo byin rlabs gtor ma'i rim pa rnams ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma nyer gsum sor bzhag rab 'bar ma'i zhal bzhi pa'i bstod pa yan rgyun bzhin dang / de nas dur khrod sha za kun gyi gtso/ zhes sogs sangs rgyas bstan srung ma rgyas pa sor bzhag gong ma rnams dang 'dra zhing / dbyangs res med/ bkra shis kyi bar gong bzhin la kyai rdor bkra shis rdzogs nas/ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sogs/ chos skyong gi bkra shis rgyas pa bcas grub nas/ slob dpon gyis zor gtor rnams sgo phyogs la bsgyur/ gtor 'degs pa rnams kyis 'phen sar bskyal/ spyi mchod pa sogs kyis mchod gtor bya khra mar bton la/ phul ma grub kyi bar bya khyi sogs bsrungs/ 'cham sku do dam pa rnams kyis 'cham sku tshang ma 'cham khang gi tshoms chung dang / 'chams rwa'i khug yol bas bcad pa sogs gang 'os su zhal khebs dang / gyon chog bcos la bzhag de lta'i gra sgrig rnams phal cher grub pa dang / dung mkhan gyis tshogs su chos dung btang nas/ bzhi thog tu sleb bstun thog mar nged rang dpon g.yog de nas chos drung / rkang gling rnga rol ba rnams byon nas khri chen gyi rab gsal lho ma'i gdong tsam du nged rang sogs rnga pa rnams shar bstan dang / rol mo ba rnams nub lta gral ring 'drongs par bsgrigs pa'i rnga ba'i dbus su nged rang dang / g.yas g.yon la dbyangs dpon sogs tshogs pa rnams rgan rim gyi gral dang / rol mo'i dbus su ban gtsang dbu byed che ba g.yas g.yon dbu byed gnyis rgyab brgya dpon bod gling dbu byed dbyangs dpon sogs g.yas g.yon cha snyoms gral rim gyi g.yas mthar/

chos dung rkang gling dkyus zhwa 'khar rnga phye phur/ g.yon mthar chos 'khor lhun po'i rol sil phye phur 'os 'tshams dang bcas bsgrigs rnga rol tshogs pas ma ldengs na 'bul sdud bla ma dang / byang bsgrigs rgyud zur sdod rnams bskul srol 'dug bcom dung bcom rol gsum brdeg lan can 'phar ma'i chem brdung la rkang gling g.yab dar/ shā sa na gtso dbyangs/ nyis brdeg 'phar ma grub nas dkar yol gtong zhing / ja dang / ja mchod phun tshogs gtsug nor ma/ ja grub nas dkar yol bsdus la chab btang / dbyangs res mdzad pa rnams bsdoms nas/ mgon po'i bka' gnyan/ khro la rngams pa/ 'jigs byed dbyings las/ nag mo bzang mo rnams gtso dbyangs/ spyan bgrad skra brdzes/ dpal ldan 'phrin las/ dgra bgegs tshar gcod/ bsad pa'i sha dang rnams g.yas gral/ mgon po'i bka' nyan nag mo gnod sbyin/ rngams pa'i stabs kyi sngon tshe gsang sngags/ dam tshig 'dzin khyod rnams g.yon gral gyis bya zhing / gnod sbyin yab yum gyi bstod par 'gyings dbyangs/ pu tra ming sring gi bstod pa dang / 'phrin 'chol shlau ka gcig la su men bcug nas/ gnod sbyin yum dang / sring mo'i bstod mgo dang / tshig lhad sbrel mtshams la bhyoḥ'adren/ gzhan thams cad la hūm̐ 'dren 'gying dbyangs ma rdzogs bar la rol mo nyis brdeg 'phar ma/ 'gying dbyangs rdzogs pa'i nyis brdeg 'phar ma grub nas/ 'then rkang 'phar ma gnyis dang / rnga yom 'phar med lnga brdeg gcig chung gcig che gcig rnams su su men gyi rol mo'i 'then rkang gi mgo thams cad la rnga yom dzar ma gtogs pa'i rol mo'i rigs thams cad la chos dung rkang gling / g.yab dar 'khar rnga phye phur sprug pa rnams byas nas sku 'cham pa rnams tho zur gsal bzhin 'byon/ 'di skabs rin sdings pa'i 'chams 'di phur pa'i grub 'chams yin te/ phyag deb rnying ma rnams las bla ma 'chams pas grub 'chams gzabs ma byed ces gsungs so/

/bstod bskul rnams grub pa'i rol mo 'phar rdzogs pa dang / gsum brdeg lan can rol skor de nas chig brdung gi ngang nas bya khra mar byon/ phyir 'byin pa dang 'chams ring chos dung rkang gling g.yab dar 'khar rnga phyed phur sprug pa 'og ma rnams la rigs 'gre/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku thog la bla brang zam par slob dpon byon pa dang rol mo bsgyur bar gsungs shing / a mes zhabs kyis 'chams sku rnams bya khra mar byon grub nas rol mo bsgyur bar gsungs pas/ deng sang yang de bzhin mdzad pa bzhin 'chams sku tshang ma bya khra mar byon bstun rol mo bzhi brdeg tu bsgyur ba dang / grwa tshang mchod dpon gyis sna drangs nas rnga pa rnams 'chams 'gros kyis 'gro/ rnga rol gral 'grigs pa dang / rol mo ba rnams 'chams sar bltas la nag rengs pa sogs kyis rkang grangs med pa'i 'chams las mkhan lngas dzaṃ len sngon 'gro'i bzhi 'gros/ 'chams sku rnams kyis sprug sig bzhi 'gros shud 'gros ma rnams ci rigs grub nas gral 'grigs pa dang / bcu bzhi brdeg nyis brdeg len med rol skor 'bebs bcas rnams grub nas gung gseng / 'dus nas dkar yol ja/ ja mchod bskal bzang ma/ mjug gi gdangs ring bcas/ ja mchod/ dkar yol bsdus/ dpa' chang gi phud spyi mchod pas phud phor du bteg pa la slob dpon gyis mtheb srin gyis gtor/ chab dang / bcom dung / bcom rol rnams rgyun bzhin/ nam mkha' 'brug sgra dbyangs res kyis dpal ldan mgon po dang / snang srid lha srin gnyis gtso dbyangs/ rdo rje nag po chen po dang / mkha' lding ce spyang g.yas gral lcam dral khyed kyi dang / ye shes mgon po gnyis g.yon gral gyis byed pa'i 'go thams cad du/ hūm̐ ngo / bhyo'o/ wā/ wā ya zhes sbyar snga thog de phyin yang dbyangs res kho na bkra shis kyi bar mdzad srol yod 'dug kyang / dus phyis 'dir bzhugs gzhi bdag nas/

bkra shis kyi bar gtsang dbyangs pa kho nas bskul bas/ de yang hūm̐ 'dren bcug nas/ 'dir bzhugs gzhi bdag nas/ sman raka gi bar la dbyangs skor cig sngar bcol legs pa man shar nub kyi gtor 'bul bzhin te dbyangs srin thung / bdud dang ma'i rol mo/ chem brdung gi 'gor 'then rkang gsum sogs gong bzhin/ spyi btab ma rdzogs bar la rkang gling g.yab dar mi dgos/ chems brdung rdzogs nas rol mo gcig ge gnyis gsum mo byas kyi mu nas g.yul thang du 'byon pa dang rkang gling g.yab dar/ gtor bzlog rnams kyi rol tshig 'di bzhin la bla ma gong mas gsungs pa dang bzhi brdung gsungs pa sna tshogs yod kyang gnyis ka'i dgongs pa rol grangs gong bkod bzhin yin/ 'di nas gtor ma 'phangs ma tshar gyi bar 'byon bzhugs thams cad la rnga phyir brdung kho na yin/ 'cham sku las mkhan sogs kyi 'chams grub pa dang gsum brdeg lan can/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma yongs rdzogs la gang thugs ma'i bu dbyangs bcug nas shlau ka re re'i mtshams su dzar dang gsum brdeg bcas grub pa dang / gsum brdeg gi ngang nas smad zhing du byon nas/ 'chams sku las mkhan sogs kyi 'cham grub pa dang / nyis brdeg lan can du bsgyur nas pho nya bskul drug cu pa bzhin la rkang gling pa phyogs tha dad du mi 'gro zhing / dzar la'ang mi 'bud/ mdun gyi pho nya bskul gyi rol mo nyis brdeg rdzogs nas 'then rkang gsum dang chems brdung / chos dung grags dung snga thog dam rdzas gtor ma rnams dmod bcol dang bcas bsgyel nas satwa res gsil te gtor rnying phyung ba zhig yod 'dug kyang / dus phyis yab rje rdo rje 'chang dang nged rang gi ring la zor 'phangs kyi phyag len 'gad gtsang du btang nas/ zor las pa rnams kyi sngags dang dmod pa ma rdzogs bar mdun du bzhag 'phangs ran pa dang / spyi mchod nag rengs pa sogs gtor ma 'degs rogs su bskul nas gtor rtse nub tu bstan te sa la brdabs/

phod sne'ang sa la brdabs/ snga thog gi phyag srol la gtor ma 'phangs rin 'chams sku tshang ma 'bags sprug gi rnam pas gtor ma 'phangs phyogs la dbu sgur nas sprug pa zhig 'dug cing / gtor ma 'phangs grub nas 'chams sku dang zor las pa rang phyogs la zhal bstan pa dang rol mo che ba bzhi rgyab la bzhag nag rengs pa gsum gyis gtso gtor gyi snod de khyer la khrom dkyil nas zog gang lon der bsdus pa 'di srid zhi dpal 'byor ma'i skabs kyi dmigs pa dang shin tu mthun pas/ gtor de zog gis ltems bkang ba tshoms chen mdor nges par slebs pa zhig dgos/ dpon slob rnams rim gyis bya khra mar 'byor pa'i sngon du g.yag gzeng rnams dges nyams kyis 'dur rgyugs/ rnga rol gyi gral 'grigs nas 'chams sku rnams kyis zem 'gros bcas bzhugs grub pa dang / bcom dung / bcom rol 'phar med gsum srid zhi dpal 'byor ma'i dbyangs rol g.yas g.yon du 'gro ba bcas rgyun bzhin la/ deng 'dir stsol gyi mjug gi gsum brdeg dang / che gnyis rdzogs nas 'then rkang gsum rol bskor chig brdung bcas/ bcom rol nas chig brdung gi bar la rkang gling g.yab dar mi byed/ gcig brdung nas rkang gling g.yab dar sogs gong bzhin snga thog 'chams sku rnams de 'phral rang phyogs la zhal yang yang gzigs shing mgon khang nub tu phebs pa zhig yod 'dug kyang / yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi sku thog la bzhi thog tu gtang rag la spyan 'dren mdzad pa 'di shin tu 'brel chags pas dpon slob tshang ma bzhi thog tu byon pa dang / 'chams sku sngon ma tsho kun rwar byon tsam la rol mo bzhi brdung du bsgyur nas 'chams sku rnams kyis rim bzhin sku 'chams ci rigs mdzad tshar ba dang / gsum brdeg lan can rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la bzhag tshogs pa rnams gyes rol rtsis sogs phul/ ban tshang dbu byed gsum grwa tshang mchod dpon bcas la rta rgyug gzigs ja rab gsal sogs gang 'os su 'dren/

rta rgyug grub pa dang dmag ston bzhugs gral la nged rang ban tshang pa gang yod bde gling dbu byed zor las pa/ 'bag pa/ dbyangs dpon/ spyi chen/ lho'i las thog pa gdug pa 'chams sku ba sogs mi skya 'chams pa gang yod/ mthil pa'i las mtshan dmag las pa rnams tshogs nas ja dang / legs 'khur ston la brgya tsho dpon gyi bshad pa grub nas grwa tshogs la chab btang nas gyes/ mgo zla'i gnam gang la mdzad pa'i bskang gso brgya tshar 'di yang sngags 'chang chen po'i sku thog la yod pa zhig ste/ a mes zhabs kyi phur bzlog rnam bshad las/ phug ron gyi lo rgyus gsungs tshar ba'i rjes don de dag thugs la bzhag nas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen de nyid phyag len la'ang lo gsar gyi chos skyong rnams la gtang rag gi bskang gso brgya tshar gnang ba'i tshe/ dkar bdud kyi gtor ma'i mdun du phug ron gsum la sogs pa bzung ba rten khebs kyis dril nas 'jog par mdzad ces bdag gi bla ma yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan gyi gsungs las yang yang thos so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku thog la tshes gcig mnga' gsol dang sbrel nas mdzad dam snyam yang / 'di la mdzad dang bskang gso'i tho gsal ba zhig de snga ma mthong / deng sang phyag len la bskang ba 'di gnam gang la mdzad pas/ de'i tshul ni dmag ston zhugs gral grub nas lde 'phyungs pa dang / gnyer pa sogs kyi sku thang spyan gzigs bkram/ grwa tshang mchod dpon gyi phur gtor gcig the ba'i dam rdzas bcu gcig dang / mnga' gsol gyi gtor ma nor gzugs ma/ bkram bskang dmag zor ma'i dkar gtor dmar gtor/ thun gtor brgya rtsa mtshon byed/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod/ phud chang rnga rol sogs bshams/ gnam gang gi nyi shar la nged rang dang ban tshang pa/ bde gling dbu byed/ zor las pa/ stod smad bla rigs sku gnyer lto zan rnams 'tshogs nas/

phur chung gtor bsngo rgyun bzhin la zhal gyi rjes su dmag zor ma'i gtor bsngo bzlas par yang zhal gyi rjes su dmag zor ma'i sngags gsum/ gtor bsngo'i bshags pa gsum/ bskang ba dgu lugs dbyangs mtshan thogs la gzhan yang ma shar la gcig zhal rdzogs nas gung gseng / dmag zor ma'i bskang bshags rgyas pa gcig bskang bshags bsdus pa bdun/ chos dbyings spros bral ma gsum/ mgo dbyangs gcig gi sngon 'gro'i nag po gnod sbyin ma bdun/ dkar chen gyi rjes su chems brdung / mgo dbyangs gcig sngon 'gro'i gtum chen ma bdun/ sku dang gsung thugs ma bdun gyi bar mar rol mo/ rtsa brgyud bla ma/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma bdun gyi rjes mar dbyangs/ nag po mchod rten dang / dmag zor ma'i 'phrin 'chol/ nag po mchod rten dang / bskang gsar gyi bzlog pa spel ma bdun/ dmar zor ma'i bzlog pa rgyas pa gcig dang / bsdus pa bdun/ bstod pa srin gzugs ma'i sde tshan la zhal gyi rjes su dmag zor ma'i sngags dbyangs bstod pa/ pu tra man sngon tshe ma'i sde tshan bzhi la/ dus phyis nged rang gis dkar bstod gsar rtsom/ phur pa'i tshogs bsdus pa/ spyi stabs dpal ldan grub 'dzin ma/ dmag zor ma'i sgos stabs gzhan rgyun bskang bzhin la/ bkra shis kyi 'gor phur pa'i lhag ma bsdus pa bkra shis 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sogs so/ /rgyal po lo gsar la/ bskang gso brgya tshar ba dpon slob tshang ma gzab sprod bcas nam zir la tshogs nas dkar cha bzhi/ phur chung gtor bsngo/ bshags pa gsum rnams tshoms chen byas nas chab btang la rnga rol gtor ma bcas steng du bskyal la dpon slob rnams bzhengs nas/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs spyan 'dren drug cu pa bzhin byon skyems chems brdung mjug gi gsum brdeg lan can rol skor 'beb bcas byas la bzhugs/ 'bul sngags sogs rgyun bzhin/ bskang ba thugs dam ma shar ma/ dkar chung ma gcig bcas gung gseng /

gtum chen ma nas rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bar rgyun bzhin/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma bdun gyi rjes mar dbyangs/ bzlog bshags bka' bsgo'i mjug gi rol mo dgu brdung bar byas la rnga nang brdung 'phar mar bsgyur/ mgon po sogs chos skyong spyi'i mnga' gsol tsho gnyis dang / dus spyis nged rang gis zhal gyi mnga' gsol gsar brtsams rnams kyis mjug tu tshig rol/ pu tra'i mnga' gsol gyi rjes su tshig rol dgu brdung rnga phyir brdung chems brdung bzlog dung gsum brdeg lan can/ lcam dral zhal gyi sngags thung / bstod pa nag rngams ma/ rdor gru smon lam bkra shis/ phur pa'i tshogs byin rlabs/ rol mo bcom la sbram sbram zhes bcom lan dang / nyi shu rtsa gcig gi rjes su chung gcig che gcig chung gcig che gcig rnams byas la/ spyan 'dren dmigs med ma shlau ka gcig la 'gor hūm̐ ngā nga zhes sbyar la baiḍūrya sngon po'i dbyangs/ rol mo gong bzhin gyi rjes su chems brdung / 'jog tshul rgyun bzhin tshogs mchod nas bshags pa bsdus pa'i bar rgyun bzhin byas la/ gsum brdeg lan can byas la bzhag tshogs spag bkye/ chab btang lhag ma bsdu/ rdor dril 'thor nas rnga rol dung bcas tshoms chen du byon nas mjug chog rgyun bskang bzhin la/ bkra shis kyi 'gor lhag ma bsdus pa/ bkra shis la 'jigs rung sogs grol dung bcas/ tshogs bkyed dang lhag ma 'di sngar lo gsar bzhugs gral thog grwa tshogs la bkyed pa'i lhag ma bsdus nas/ kha phrus sngags phyag rgya byed pa zhig 'dug kyang / rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i tshogs dang tsā ru'i bza' ba'i lugs gnyis ka mi 'dra bas nged rang gi thog la phyag len gad gtsang du bsgyur/ snga sor bskang ba'i phyed tsam la chos sde lho nas mkhan spyi chen rab 'byams pa gzhon pa gnyis bcas byon nas mnga' gsol mnyam du mdzad/ steng du bskul res dung mkhan/ mchod dpon rnams ma gtogs gzhan rnams la 'chams sku phebs skyel gyi rol sil bton/

rol sil gyi 'phros rnams kyi rnga brdungs byas la/ pu tra bskul sogs gtor 'bul rgyun bzhin/ 'on kyang deng sang gi gnas khang 'di na steng la 'gro ba dang / rol mo kha bsgyur ba sogs kyis sa yul mi 'dug cing / sa yul 'os pa shar tshe gang 'os bya/ srid zhi dpal 'byor ma'i g.yas g.yon gyi gom 'gros mtshon byed rang rang gi lus g.yas g.yon la yam tsam re byed/ dpal mgon ma hā kā la sogs kyi rol mo gsum brdeg che gnyis bcas grub pa dang / rol bskor gcig brdung gi ngang nas kun rwa phyogs su rol mo ba thog mar thon pa dang / mthil nas bsnyen song sogs grwa gang 'os kyis rol dang rkang gling g.yab dar bcas dang / rdzag dung bus mdung nag khyer mi bcas bsgrigs/ dbu byed che ba dang bsgul ris rol sil rnga rol/ dum tsam zhig bzhi thog zhol shag 'khor gyi steng la bsgrigs/ rnga rol byings dang / chos dung / rkang gling / rdzag dung / rgya gling / 'cham sku'i 'go pa/ khrims gnon pa 'os 'tshams dang bcas mthil du bsgrigs la/ rol mo bzhi brdung du bsgyur mtshams mtshams su rkang gling g.yab dar dang bcas/ tshoms chen nas nag reng rnga zlum theb zhwa can a tsar ba rnams rkang grangs med pa'i 'chams kyis 'thon/ 'chams sku rnams rim bzhin byon byung ba dang / gong du bshams pa'i mthil pa rnams sngon la phal cher phyin khrims gnon pa rnams snga rting gang 'os su bsdad/ mgon po rnams kyi sku 'chams ci rigs mdzad mu nas mgon khang nub kyi 'chams sku gang yod rim bzhin phyir byon/ 'di dag sgo phyogs la dud mdzad gong du cung zad 'khyil tsam re bzhugs pa des sngon gyi phyag len phyir bltas gzigs pa'i dod tshang / bzhi thog gi 'chams sku rnams thog mar phyir phebs rnams dang 'dra ba la/ slar nang du 'khyil te sku 'chams ci rigs mdzad grub pa dang / gsum brdeg lan can rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la rnga rol gyis/

tshoms chen steng gi mdung pa rnams lha rgyal dang grol dung / 'chams sku rnams mgon khang so sor phebs/ sder kha bsgrigs grub pa dang / lo gsar la nged rang dang mnga' gsol ba gang yod/ der ma 'dus pa'i bla ma zur bsdad dpon slob dbu chen/ spyi chen/ lha khang las thog pa/ bde mchog lcang gnyer phyi nang gi bla mgron khag che gras/ gzhi gnyer khag dmag las pa/ de nyin dung rgya gling pa rnams la gral bkod mgron gnyer gyis byed/ gsol ba chos spyod sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya gang 'og gi bsgrigs bcas drug pa tshes bzhi bzhin gyi rjes su/ rab mdzes ma'i sde tshan la bzang spyod bzhag pa/ ja mchod gang 'os bcas/ sder kha gtong ring mkhan chen gyi gsung bshad/ ja gang 'os la rgya gling / sder ma bsdus nas chab btang la gsung bshad rdzogs nas zhwa gyon nas gyes/ de'i pang nas bzung gtor spod rnams gong bkod bzhin no// ༄༅/ /swasti/ yang dus mdos gzabs ma ma zhes sngags 'chang chen po'i sku thog la/ gdung brgyud khrir phebs dang nye bar dus mdos dang chab gcig kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa'i gzigs snang las mkhan ru 'dren gyi 'chams gzabs bsham bcas mdzad pa'i phyag deb mdor bsdus sngags 'chang nyid kyis mdzad pa de na nyer drug gi 'chams sku spyan 'dren phye phur la sogs pa shin tu gzab par byed ces dang / yang mgon des mdzad pa'i deb chen rin chen gter mdzod las/ lo dus kyi dus mdos chen mo rgyang nas/ rgyal zla'i nyer drug la chos skyong spyan 'dren shin tu gzabs dngos/ gdan drangs cho ga tshugs par mdzad/ nyer bdun la 'chams res dkyus ma gang rgyas/ nyer brgyad la nged rang dpon slob tshang mas gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi gzigs snang bzhin ru 'dren las mkhan gyi 'chams rgyas pa/ nyer dgu la phyir mdos rgyag de thog nged rang gi mnga' zhabs stod smad thams cad kyi rgyab dmag gzabs bshams byas zhes dang /

yang rje des mdzad pa'i 'chams yig las kyang gzabs bshams dgos tshul gsung / 'on kyang sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rab de dag na 'chams kyi rnam gzhag gsal zhing / cho ga phyag len gyi babs bsgrigs lam tsam las ma gsungs pas/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs yan la sngags 'chang chen pos ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin la/ chog bsgrigs dang / grabs bsham rgyas bsdus sna tshogs byung 'dug cing / 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gi sku thog la rgyal sras kun dga' bkra shis che 'don mdzad pa'i skabs su mchod zhing bya khra mas 'ong bzhes 'bru phung la dar lcog btsugs nges 'chams bslab sbyangs kyi tho 'grom/ mgo zla'i mjug gi mdos tshab ban tshang bsnyen song bcas kyis phur bzlog rgyal zla'i tshes gcig la rje nyid dang ban tshang sto zan bcas kyi na bza' gzabs spros/ lha bsangs/ lo gsar bzhugs gral gtor spod dang chab gcig sgo rum/ nang so skyed lhas/ bsam gling / tshoms chen mgon khang steng rnams su ru mtshon gsar 'dzugs/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu lha mthil khyams smad du mgon de dbu byed bzhi/ brgya dpon/ dgu tshan 'go mi lnga dur khrod bdag po/ rnga chung pa dang ru 'dren sde bzhi'i mgo mi gnyis te/ rkang gling 'bud mi gnyis bcas kyi chog bsgrigs/ tshes nyer gcig la skyes che chung phye bzhi brgyas/ rang rang gi go gang 'grigs khyer nas 'go mi rnams kyi go rtsis/ tshes nyer gsum la 'chams sku spyan 'dren gzabs ma dang / gsung chog dkyus bzhin/ tshes nyer bzhi la gzhan dkyus bzhin la chos nyid ma bzhag pa/ 'chams sbyangs mnyam chas lha khang rdo gcal du mdzad nas ja dang po gcig brdung / gnyis pa bdun brdung / tshes nyer lnga la chos nyid ma/ tshes nyer lnga nas tshes nyer brgyad bar nag po mchod rten gsum sogs rgyun bzhin/ tshes nyer drug la shar pa'i gtor 'bul grub nas/ 'bag dang zhwa theb zhwa nag rnga chung pa'i chas bkyed/

tshes nyer bdun la bdud rtsi lnga mchod/ nub pa'i gtor 'bul/ sa 'dul/ 'chams phod dang g.yang bzhi bkyed/ tshes nyer brgyad la sku dang gsung thugs ma yan nam lang la grol nas/ chas zhugs mdzad de gser skyems grol nas gong ma khri'u chung la bzhugs/ rnga rol kha lho bstan gyi ru 'dren las mkhan gyi 'chams mdzad nas/ ja dang po skyes chung rdzogs mtshams/ gnyis pa gar zhus ma gsal/ gcig brdung rdzogs nas spyi pa'i gsol ja bdun tshan/ gsum pa bdun brdung gcig gnyis gang rigs la/ bskul dang 'chams tshang ma da lta bzhin gsol ba dgong dung snga chog gi 'phros mdzad/ tshes nyer dgu la rgyun bzhin la skyes che chung mi rta'i go gang 'grig bcas mdzad tshul 'dug sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyi sku thog la/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang 'khrungs lor dus mdos kyi sku rim dmar chen gtor bzlog zla ba gang la gnang ma gsal yang / de nyid kyi gsung rtsom phyag deb 'di nang bzhin mdzad/ dus mdos kyi chas phal cher dang / gser zangs ru mtshon 'di rnams gsar bzhengs 'ong zhes dar 'dzugs tho 'grem gyi skabs skyes che chung la gnyer dpon gyis bkram/ rnga rol dang gzhan 'go pa gang yod la phyag mdzod kyi bkod chab bcas bkram/ tshes nyer gsum la 'chams sku spyan 'dren ban tshang bla rigs dbyangs dpon sogs bzhi bcu skor gyis byas nas gzhan rgyun bzhin la/ mdung lnga/ hā shang lnga 'phar/ 'chams sku brgyad kyis steng grags blo lcam dral dang khyad byang 'chams sku gsum phebs/ cho ga nyer bzhi bzhin/ tshes nyer bzhi la tshogs dung snga bar btang nas nyer gsum sor bzhag gtor 'bul dbyangs chags/ mnyam chas gong bzhin/ tshes nyer lnga nas tshes nyer brgyad bar yang gong bzhin la/ tshes nyer brgyad kyis tshogs dung snga bar btang nas gsung bsngo yan/ de phyin tshang ba gong bzhin mnyam chas dang dngos gzhi gnyis char la bzhugs khri mdzad/ nged rang skyes skabs kyang 'di nang bzhin la/

de lo nas bzung dge slong dang sngags par rol chen mdzad/ yab rje dang nged rang khri 'don skabs/ maṅga'i mtshan can khri phebs sor bzhag la/ zla dgu nang dmar chen gtor bzlog zla bcu gcig nang phur bzlog dang / dza lung pas khro rol/ nged rang gi rim gror/ de'i khar grwa tshogs 'phral nas rgyal zla'i zhal gyi gtor bzlog bsu ba dang / 'jigs byed drug cu sku rim chen mo bzhin/ yab rje khri phebs mdos gzabs nas bud med 'chams pa mi skyar bsgyur/ nged rang khri 'don mdos gzabs la nyer brgyad tshogs kyis 'phyar dar bcu gsum gyi mdun lha mchod kyi mdung bco brgyad 'dzin mi bcas dang / khri chen nas bkra shis khra ring bcas bsham zhing / cho ga dang 'chams tshang ma gong ma bzhin la/ mdos gzabs rjes ma 'di rnams kyi skabs maṅga'i mtshan can yab sras kyi gser skyems la zhwa nag mchod srol byung 'dug pas/ gang ltar de yan la sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung tho mdor bsdus de las gzhan gdung brgyud zhal ngo'i deb bsgrigs mdzad pa ni mi 'dug pas/ slan chad sngags 'chang chen po dang / a mes zhabs kyi dgongs pa dang mi 'gal zhing rtogs sla ba'i phyir nag 'gros gsar bris lta bur 'bri na/ gdung brgyud 'khrungs skabs su mdos gzabs byed tshul dang / che 'don la byed tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni 'khrungs lo de'am/ gsang rgya sogs kyi stabs lo kha shas nas byed par spro na/ zla dgu nang gi dmar chen gtor bzlog nged rang gi phyag deb chen mo bzhin/ tha skar dang smin zla gang rung gi tshes mgo gza' skar bzang bar 'ong zhes dar 'dzugs kyi dgos cha mdzod deb bzhin dang / rnga rol las mkhan dge slong sngags 'chams pa rnams kyi 'go pa mdzod pa'i mdun bsgrigs tho 'grem bkod khyab gsol ras 'os 'tshams/ skyes che chung bud med rnams kyi 'go pa dang / de gras nye bskor rnams la'ang bzhes skabs gnyer dpon gyis tho 'grem bkod khyab 'go pa rnams kyis gtso bo sngags 'chang chen po dang /

a mes zhabs kyi 'chams dpe nang bzhin mthong brgyud shes pa'i/ slob dpon la rnga chung dang so so'i phyag mtshan bcas 'khyer dngos bslabs nas/ gdung brgyud sku nar son zhing skyon yon gyi zhal ta gnang thub pa yod na de'i drung dang / de min gdung brgyud kyi sku drung 'chams kyi slob dpon des rnga rol bcas rgyugs len skabs/ thog mar dge slong dang sngags pa gnyis kyis 'chams dngos gzhi gsum re dang / log 'chams ci rigs byed bcug dgu tshan bdun gyi 'go par lam 'gros dang / dgu brdung gsum re/ gzhan rnams tshar re/ dpang gzugs/ 'das dang ma/ dpal ldan mgon po ma rnams re mos kyis btang nas/ 'chams tshang mar lus kyi rnam 'gyur rkang stabs lag stabs sogs la skyon 'don dgos pa yod na slar yang sbyangs nas/ 'chams rgyug tshar gcig gong bzhin dang / skyon 'don mi dgos na 'og ma rnams kyis rang rang gi 'og la gong bzhin slob bcug skyes che chung bud med rnams kyi 'go par yang skabs bstun/ 'chams rgyugs bslabs la gong bzhin byed/ gzhis dang phyogs kyi 'chams pa tshang mas 'chams rgyugs rim bzhin 'bul skabs bzhi thog kun rwa'i nub kyi shag steng nged rang dang mdzod pa/ brgya dpon/ ban gtsang dbu byed gsum/ bde gling dbu byed rnams kyis rnga rol bcas rnga chung pa chas so so'i 'chams 'khor gsum re/ ru 'dren pa 'chams pa tshang ma gnyis re bsdebs/ so so'i 'chams bskor gsum re/ dge slong dang sngags pas 'khar gsil lhung bzed dang ban phur bzhi re mos/ skyes che chung rnams kyi gri phub bcas/ ru 'dren sde tshan re rdzogs pa dang / log 'chams sbubs gnon/ pu tra ba rnams la 'chams rgyugs gong bzhin ban ral bcas nyin gnyis gsum la phral nas gang tshar gnon/ dus mdos 'phrin 'chol skabs nged rang / mdos la mkhan chen 'byon na de dang / rgya las gsum/ ban tshang pa/ bde gling dbu byed/ sku gnyer lto zan/

nged rang gi g.yog tshang ma gzabs gyon thog sgo rum/ nang sor bsangs chen/ mgon khang khag bzhir bskang gso gtong rim gong bzhin bgyid rgyu la/ rtse mchod dpon gyis dngul sder sogs su dam rdzas gsum/ sgo rum nang sor bkram bskang / nang sor 'dzugs gtor che bar rtse rgyan mda' dar bcas/ skyed lhas su dam rdzas dang bskang gtor gong bzhin zhal gyi dkar gtor dmar gtor bsam gling du gong bzhin la dmag zor ma'i dkar gtor dmar gtor bcas 'phrin 'chol byed/ mgo zla'i nyer gcig la chog bsgrigs gzhi thog kun rwar bgyid rgyur/ rnga rol gong bzhin 'dug la mkhan chen 'byon na de dang rol sil gnyis rnga gnyis/ chos dung mtshon byed dkar po chos 'phel dngul gshog ma dung mkhan gyis 'bud cing mang dung la 'gro skabs gzhan la bcol/ mthil gyi shar gnyer tshang mdo'i g.yabs la dung / rgya gling / rdzag dung rnams bsgrigs/ shar gyi rdo skas nas/ nub tu 'dom do tsam sar lho byang la 'jam gdan/ nged rang sogs gser skyems pa bco lngas mthil du 'chams gral bsgrigs la nged rang gi lag tu phud phor chang bcas thogs/ phud dam dang srog snod rtse mchod dpon gyis khyer/ bdud rtsi byin brlabs nas bzung / gser skyems yongs rdzogs dbyangs rol 'chams bcas rgyun bzhin la/ bcom dung bcom rol gyi 'gor 'phar blangs/ gsum brdeg lan can nas 'chams mjug gi chems brdungs la sgang dung bcas mgon mdos gsar btsugs bzhin/ gser skyems grub nas nged rang rnga gral la 'dug tshar ba dang / ru 'dren spyan 'dren gyi bcom rol rgyun gyi gser skyems bzhin la/ chems brdung la sgang dung / gsum brdeg lan med/ khyed kyi dang / bstan dgra sogs dge slong spyan 'dren yas bsdu mas bsdu'i rjes ma'i rol mo gsum brdeg rdzogs nas chems brdung la rkang gling pa gnyis rang 'gros kyis 'thon nas/ sum skras kyi thad tsam nas tshoms chen la bltas la rkang gling g.yab dar de nas shar gyi gdan stengs tshoms chen la kha bltas nas langs/

spos phor ba gnyis kyang rang 'gros kyis thon rjes rnga chung pas sna drangs dge slong rnams rim bzhin 'chams la rnga chung pa dang gnyis 'gag tu bsdad/ gzhan der 'khor rim bzhin tshoms chen du log la rjes mas rdzogs mtshams kyis gsal rnga rol phyogs su lus dang lag pa dud la rnga chung pa dang bcas pa log rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la bzhag de bzhin du sngags pa dang / bud med la'ang spyan 'dren tshig sdud dang / 'chams tshul tshang ma 'dra zhing / spyan 'dren gyi rol mo gsum brdeg snga ma la rkang gling g.yab dar/ rjes ma'i chems brdung la rkang gling g.yab dar/ spos phor ba gnyis ni rnga chung pa thams cad kyi sngon la phyin nas do rwa 'khor bstun nang du log dge slong 'chams sna 'chams gzhug gi 'khar bsil lhung bzed sngags pa 'chams sna 'chams gzhug gi ban phur/ sgang dung rkang gling 'chams gzhan nas bdun re dang / bud med gsum re 'thon mtshams su 'bud/ bud med rdzogs nas gung gseng / skyes che chung par spyan 'dren gyi rol mo gsum brdeg gnyis ka la rkang gling g.yab dar/ rnga rol bzhag rnga chung pas sna drangs la 'chams tshul lag cha bcas gong bzhin la rnga chung pa gnyis phud pa'i skyes chen pa gsum re dus la thon/ dur khrod bdag po'i spyan 'dren gyi 'gor yang bcom rol gong bzhin la nyis brdeg lan med dgos te/ 'chams des snang ba 'gyur thub las nyung 'chams pa'i bskul gyi sngon du bcom rol dgos par gsungs so/ /spyan 'dren dur khrod sha za dang / bstan dgra brlag phyir sogs tshig sdud/ dbyangs dkar mo ba'i spyan 'dren rol mo/ nyis brdeg lan can chems brdung bcas/ rkang gling pa gnyis phebs bsu'i tshul gyi sgo dang nye bar 'ongs la rkang gling g.yab dar/ de nas rang 'gros dal bas rim gyis gdan khar phyin/ spos phor ba gnyis kyis sna drangs/ nor skyong 'chams pa gnyis bde chas kyis 'chams dang bcas liṅga len tshul byas nas log 'chams kyis log

thon skabs kyi chems brdung dang liṅga khyer tshul log 'chams rnams tshugs pa dang sgang dung rkang gling g.yab dar dang bcas grub nas gung gseng / las mkhan spyan 'dren gyi bcom rol ru 'dren bzhin/ gnod sbyin yab yum dang / bstan dgra brlag pa sogs tshig sdud shlau ka gcig byas la/ rkang gling pas phebs bsu/ spos phor bas sna 'dren/ 'chams dpon dang / dgu tshan 'go pa/ 'chams gzhug pa rnams kyis ban ral thogs gzhan rnams la mi dgos/ dgu tshan sngon mi'i dang po su yin de myur stabs kyis 'thon la bcom tshul lan gsum byas nas bzhi 'gros sogs lam 'gros tshugs pa dang spos phor ba gnyis dang bcas 'chams/ 'chams pa gnyis pa de thon pa dang / spos phor ba rnams do rwa'i dkyil dang / thog mar thon pa des do rwa bskor ba'i sna drangs 'chams pa gang yod kyis lam 'gros tshar re byas nas do rwar 'gro/ 'chams dpon dbus su slebs nas lam 'gros kyi 'phro bcad pa dang / spos phor ba'i 'chams bzhag la rkang gling pa gnyis kyi g.yas g.yon du bsdad/ dgu tshan bdun gyi 'go pa dang / pu tra gyon mi gnyis ngo shes par byas la thon byung re bzhin dang gcig brdung / gnyis brdung / gsum brdung / bzhi brdung / lnga brdung / drug brdung / bdun brdung / brgyad brdung / dgu brdung rnams kyi 'chams dngos gzhi tshugs pa dang / sgang dung / rkang gling g.yab dar/ 'chams yongs rdzogs tshar gcig dgug gzhug dang lha dbye gcig la chems brdung gi tshe rkang gling pa gnyis kyis kha phyir bltas nas 'bud cing g.yab dar las sgang dung mi 'bud/ dpang gzugs/ 'das dang ma/ dpal ldan mgon po rnams yongs rdzogs/ bdun brdung grub pa'i chems brdung la 'chams dpon rnga gral du 'gro/ gzhan rnams kun rwa'i skya rtsa sogs la phyir bkyed de sgor/ dkar dung drag dung gcig dang / dung chen phra ngar thengs bdun tsam/ tshoms chen nas bud med kyi rnga chung pa glo bur du thon nas kun rwa'i dkyil tsam du kha byang bstan la 'dug pa dang /

gzhan tsho phyogs thams cad nas glo bur du rgyugs la zings shing rgyug tshul dum tsam byas nas sked skabs tsam du slebs pa dang / drag dung dang / dung chen gong bzhin te tshul 'di dngos gzhi'i skabs liṅga sgrol ba dang bud med sha skal len pa'i phyir liṅgar rub pa dang 'grig par byed/ de nas shar gyi rdo skas kyi lho zur du rnga chung pa gnyis kha lhor bstan bsgrigs pa'i rgyab nas bud med 'chams pa gang yod bsgrigs pa'i rjes su/ dge slong gi rnga chung pa dang / 'chams pa gang shong bsgrigs/ bud med rnga chung pas nub phyogs su cung zad rgyugs la/ log 'chams blangs pa dang / bud med dge slong rnams kyis log 'chams dus gcig tu tshugs/ dge slong 'chams pa'i rjes su sngags pa'i rnga chung pa'ang thon nas rim bzhin log skabs rnga chung pa rnams rang rang gis sna drangs pa'i 'chams tshan ma rdzogs bar la sgo 'gag tu bsdad so so'i 'chams zhugs pa dang mnyam du log sngags pa'i 'chams zhugs pas rdzogs mtshams kyis gsal rnga rol bar byung ba dang rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la bzhag skyes chen pa rnams kyang / bud med log 'chams len pa nas 'thon la rim bzhin log de rdzogs pa dang skyes chung pa'ang de bzhin logs/ de nas 'chams dpon 'chams sna 'dren mi'i gong du kha shar bstan 'dug la rol mo bcom/ chems brdung gi rjes su rol sil si li li bar blangs pa dang / sgang dung rkang gling g.yab dar/ g.yas log g.yon log gsum grub mtshams brgyad brdung phyi nang gsang ba ma grub nas dgu brdung tshugs pa dang / spos phor ba gnyis 'chams dpon gyi sngon la rang 'gros kyis phyin/ rkang gling pa gnyis 'chams kyi phyir 'chams gzhug tu yong la/ 'chams gral rim bzhin dogs su btang / 'chams dpon dang 'chams gzhug pa gnyis ma thug tsam byas nas 'chams pa sgo dang nye rim bzhin dgu brdung 'phag shad che ba dang / gzhan rnams kyis snyoms par byas la rim bzhin log

dgu tshan drug rdzogs mtshams re re rkang gling re 'bud/ g.yab dar mi byed/ bdun pa rdzogs nas rkang gling kyang mi 'bud par rkang gling pa rjes ma des 'chams rdzogs pas gsal rnga rol bar byung bstun rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la bzhag grol dung gtong / de nas dpon slob kun gyes/ chog bsgrigs la 'chams ja gsum gyi dang po bud med rdzogs mtshams/ gnyis pa pu tra'i sum brdung rdzogs mtshams/ gsum pa bdun brdung gnyis rdzogs mtshams su gtong zhing / dang po de 'chams pa ser skya tshang ma tshoms chen phu mdar gangs shongs byas nas zhu/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa ru 'dren 'chams pa la gong bzhin dang / pu tra ba byings mthil du sgor nged rang rnga gral du yong nas zhu/ ja mchod rigs la dung rgya gling gtong / de nyin gyi dus ja dang phyi 'dren sogs mang ja rnams kyang skabs gang 'os su gtong / rnga rol dang pu tra 'chams par chab/ grwa 'chams pa rnams ther gzan spu phrug gang rigs lh+wam gsar pa/ mi skya rnams zhwa gos lh+wam gsar pa/ sngar rnga chung pa dang / skyes che chung pa rnams la lag cha yod pa ma gtogs 'chams pa gzhan tshor mi 'dug cing gser skyems dang pu tra'i 'chams dpon gyi rdo rje 'khyer yang da nas bzung gong bzhin te/ chog bsgrigs kyi rnam bzhag go/ ༈ /nyer gnyis la mchod gtor dang / rgyag gtor sogs kyi dgos cha sngon gyi phyag deb bzhin dang dbyibs dang bsham lugs bcas deng sang bzhin/ grwa tshang dang spyi mchod pa/ gtso thabs la sogs kyis byed/ tshoms chen gyi thog 'khor mar 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gi sku thog la bzhengs pa'i gos kyi bla re/ seng g.yabs kyi gdong la a mes zhabs kyi lda ldi gying 'khor mar maṅga'i mtshan can yab sras dang / nged rang gi thog la bzhengs pa'i gos yol/ gnam yangs la a mes zhabs kyi drag po'i ras yol zheng chung / gdung khebs 'khor mar yab rje'i sku thog gi gos kyi lce le/

ka ba rnams la ka dar ci 'byor/ sgo nang gi ka drung 'bag rkang bzhi/ gos lh+wam bcas par khrab rmog gzab khyad can gdong gral gyi ka ring gnyis dang / ka thung gnyis/ rgyab gral g.yas g.yon gyi ka ba rnams la go mtshon ci 'byor nub kyi skya rtsa nas shar bstan la nged rang gi khri/ gung gral g.yas g.yon 'jags gdan gyi gral 'gor ban tshang dbu byed gsum/ bde gling dbu byed/ yul chen slob dpon gnyis rnams la sgo grum/ lu gdong dbu byed dbyangs dpon rnams la grum yug de 'phros 'jabs gdan/ rgyab gral g.yas kyi gral 'gor brgya tsho dpon dang / 'dar grang slob dpon la 'bol grum/ dbyangs dpon la grum yug gzhan 'jabs gdan/ mtha' gral g.yas kyi 'jabs gdan 'gor 'dar grong dbu byed la sgor grum/ mkhan chen phebs na gong gral gyi 'gor sa gdan khri rgyab yol gsol lcog 'jabs gdan 'gor grwa tshang mchod dpon la sger grum/ zor las par grum yug rgyab gral g.yon gyi 'jabs gdan 'gor dung mkhan la sger grum/ dbyangs dpon la grum yug de rgyab spyi mchod par sger grum/ grwa tshogs ma shom na mtha' gral g.yon la 'jabs gdan/ sgo nang g.yas la mthil pa'i las tshan dang dung chen/ rdzag dung pa rnams kyi gdan/ sgo nang g.yon la skya bo pa'i gdan bcas gra bsgrigs/ ༈ /nyer gsum snga bar ban tshang pa phyed bsgos kyi dus gtor dang gur drag de mtshungs tshogs chen cho ga'ang nam langs yan ma grol bar byas/ 'chams sku do dam pa sku gnyer bsnyen song dang mthil pa'i 'chams sku gyon mi rnams kyi khyad 'phags lho byang / tshoms bar gyi 'chams sku gang yod tshoms chen du bskyal nas khri'i g.yon nub nas shar gzigs la 'phags mgon gnyis/ byang nas lhor gzigs kyi gral 'gor bdag nyid ma gnyis shongs bar byas nas/ de mtshams mkhan btsun pa/ de'i 'og tu chos rje bla ma dang sngags 'chang thun mong gi 'chams sku gnyis/ grags blo ba'i 'chams sku gnyis/

mgon nub a mes zhabs kyi 'chams sku bzhi rnams dang / khri'i g.yas lho nas byang gzigs dang / nub nas shar gzigs la 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug yab sras kyi 'chams sku rnams bzhugs rgyu bcas bca' bsgrigs/ 'chams sku gdan 'dren pa dpon slob tshang ma gzabs spros ngos rol sil gang yod la gos chen gyi chos gos snam sbyar/ rnga par gos bem rnying pa gang ched dang / de 'phros snam lcam gsar pa/ deng sang dkar po rgyang grags kho na las 'bud srol mi 'dug kyang / snga thog dbyangs dpon so so'i 'og la bka' shog gnang tshe rnga mi thogs pa rnams kyis dung spos phor gsungs pa la dpag na dung mang po 'bud srol yod tshod bcas rol sil nyi shu/ de 'phros rnga/ rol sil g.yas gral gyi mthar/ dkar po rgyang grags dang / slob dpon padma'i rdzag dung / de'i g.yas su grwa tshang gi rkang gling pa gnyis/ chos sde lho'i 'khar rnga ba gnyis/ g.yon gral gyi mthar sa paṇa gyi chos dung dkar po chos 'phel dngul shog med pa/ chos rje khu dbon sogs gong ma mang po'i chos dung ya tsho ma lha bris pa'i rkang gling pa gnyis bde chen gling chos khrims pa dang sku gnyer gyi 'khar rnga/ dung bzhir dung gos/ rkang gling dang 'khar rnga sgrigs rgyug par snam chos lha bris par gzan dkyus/ mtha' bskor du gnyer tshang gis zangs dung che legs phun tshogs 'brug sgra/ gser dung 'dzam gling dbang sdud/ dngul dung dpal 'byor dar rgyas/ bod gling snyan grags dang / bsod nams nga ro bcas khyon cha lnga/ rdzag dung dang / rgya gling gnyis ka cha gnyis re/ mdung dar che legs dkar po gnyis dang nag po bzhi lha mchod kyi mdung bco brgyad/ skya bo dpon dang / gser skyems spos phor ba rgyun bzhin/ hā shang lnga rnams las dung mdung gser skyems pa/ spos phor ba rnams rgya lu chas/ rdzag dung pa cha gnyis gos dmar gzan rtse zhwa/ rgya gling pa bzhi rgya zhwa rgya gos bcas gangs nyi ma brtsegs gang la bzhi thog gi rtser bcom rol rgyun bzhin grub nas/
