thog mar mdung gcig dar dkar po gnyis gshib/ de nas dar khra dgu/ mdung nag bzhi/ dar khra dgu rnams gral bsgrigs te mar yar gnyis ka la rgyal sgo 'grim skabs mdung rtse phyir bstan nas khur/ mdung pa'i rjes su skya bo dpon/ hwa shang lnga/ dung chen skad bzang cha gnyis zangs dung che legs cha/ gser dung dngul dung cha/ rdzag dung cha gnyis/ rgya gling cha gcig phye phur gang yod/ rkang gling bzhi/ chos dung bzhi/ 'khar rnga bzhi/ rnga rol gang yod/ spos phor ba cha/ yang rgya gling pa cha/ gser skyems pa bcas gral bsgrigs/ rgyal tho sgang du spyan 'dren gyi bcom dung / dbyangs rol rkang gling 'don cha bcas rgyun bzhin dang / lag khyer ba sogs kyi grwa snga phyi gong bzhin la/ rnga rol gyi gral bca' yig bzhin gser skyems pa'i sngon la mon chung pu tra mtshon byed nag reng pa/ rnga zlum theb zhwa can/ a tsa ra rnams dang / 'chams sku gral rim gyis phebs la/ sa skya tshogs shar sgo dang nye bar thog mar mdung dar gang yod lho byang du gral ring / de mdun dung chen gang yod lho byang du gral bsgrigs pa'i mtha' gnyis su rdzag dung cha re/ dung pa'i mdun du rgya gling cha gcig de nas rnga rol gyi gral bca' yig bzhin la mtha' gnyis su dung rkang gling 'khar rnga phye phur/ nag reng pa sogs kyi rjes la/ spos phor rgya gling gser skyems rnams gang 'os su bsdad/ rol mo bsgyur ba dang gser skyems lan gsum gtor la rkang grangs med pa'i gzing 'chams/ mgon po rnams sku 'chams kyis jor nyer byon pa dang / thams cad gang gi gral rim bzhin phyin la/ bzhi thog ru mdung pa gang yod rgya gar rgya nag gi mdo'i g.yab steng la shar nas gral 'go dang / nub tu gral gzhug kha byang bstan du bsgrigs/ dung chen rdzag dung gang yod dang / rgya gling cha gcig tshoms chen nub kyi shag steng la lho nas byang du kha shar bstan la bsgrigs/ tshoms chen mdo'i sgo steng du phye phur ba gang yod spung gral du bsgrigs pa'i rgyab ru 'khar rnga bzhi/

rkang gling bzhi/ chos dung bzhi/ rnga rol gyi gral bca' yig bzhin skya bo/ hwa shang / spos phor/ gser skyems pa rgya gling cha gcig rnams/ mthil gyi gang 'os su bsdad la/ rol mo dang 'chams rgyun bzhin byas nas gyes/ mthil dang rgyal tho sgang gi bcom rol dang / sa skya tshogs kyi sku 'chams rnams la dung chen rdzag dung gang yod 'bud/ spyan 'dren gyi rol mo byings la dung chen rdzag dung cha res bskor gyis 'bud/ rgya gling gnyis ni rnam pa kun tu rtag sor dang / dkar dung rkang gling rol mo dang bstun tshang ma 'bud/ kun rwar sku 'chams kyi ring dung chen cha gnyis bsgrigs shig dang / cha gcig re mos kyis 'bud/ rdzag dung cha gnyis re mos so/ /tshogs su dung chen skad bzang cha gcig dang / rdzag dung cha gcig rkang gling dang chos dung rgyun bzhin 'chams sku rnams tshom chen du bzhugs tshar ba dang / chos dung btang nas tshogs/ gnas yo byin brlabs kyi skad gtong ba nas/ gtor bsngo'i bzlas bshams kyi mchod pa 'phrin 'chol gyi bar rgyun bzhin/ phyag 'tshal sngon 'gro'i bshags pa nas bzung / mthil chos khrims pas dung gsar 'bul ba'i bar rgyun gyi nyer bzhi sor bzhag gsol ba dgong dung bcas/ gtor 'bul ban tshang pa/ dbyangs chags mi dgos/ nyer bzhi la dung thor 'go zin tsam la btang nas/ gnas yo byin brlabs kyi skad gtong nas bzung spyan ras gzigs kyi bdag bskyed chu sbyin dzam ser nag dkar cha bzhi sogs nas bzung / bstod pa'i bar rgyun gyi nyer drug bzhin/ sngags dbyangs bstod pa sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ma'i sde tshan tshogs sogs rgyun bzhin gtor 'bul rgyab gral g.yas/ 'di nas nyer brgyad kyi bar dbyangs chags rgyun bzhin/ 'chams dbyangs mnyes chas sngar nas lha khang rdo gcal du mdzad srol 'dug kyang / da nas bzung sa skya tshogs rang du gang ci nas 'grigs cing legs 'dra bas tshogs kyi shar lho byang gsum nas thig tshad byas la dkyil drang por 'chams phyar/

de mthar 'khor mar pu tra 'chams pa'i 'jabs gdan/ de'i phyi'i shar byang gnyis su 'dom gang tsam gyi sar dge slong dang sngags pa'i 'jabs gdan me lcags 'gugs/ 'chams phyar gyi shar gyi mtha'i 'jabs gdan nang ma'i nang nas nub phyogs su khru do tsam gyi sar shar nub la rkang gling spos phor ba'i 'jabs gdan thung ngu bcas ru 'dren las mkhan rnams kyis gral gyi mtha' dbar la bud med 'chams pa rnams sha skal len pa'i tshe gang mnon su rgyug chog pa bcos/ chos khri'i lho'i rab gsal gyi dkyil thad tsam la rnga rol gyi gral sgrig rgyu'i dbus su nged rang gi 'grul khri rgyab yol lcog rtse bcas shar bstan khri'i mdun zur g.yas su grum rtse bzhi 'jabs gdan/ g.yon du mkhan chen phebs na sa gdan 'bol grum kha cha rgyab yol lcog rtse/ de'i g.yon du grum rtse lnga 'jabs gdan/ gang 'os su mdzod par sa gdan 'bol grum kha cha lcog rtse/ de'i g.yas g.yon la drung 'khor se mo ba sogs kyi gdan phur sgrub bzhin sgrig nged rang dang drung 'khor ser skya tshang ma rnga rol 'chams pa dung pa sogs gang yod gzab spros bgyis la/ nged rang gzan 'chams chas kyi phyir chos gos me long la sa zhu gos lcam rnga rol chos dung pa rnams snam lcam gsar ba rtse zhwa bcas/ bzhi thog steng nas chos dung byung 'phral chad lus med par 'dus/ nged rang dang rnga rol mdung dar dkar po gnyis/ gser dung / dngul dung / rgya gling / spos phor gdugs pa sogs/ phur sgrub kyi 'chams bzhin gral bsgrigs nas phyin la gong gi gral gdan la 'khod/ mdung pa dung rgya gling / rdzag dung rnams 'chams gdan phyir kha shar nas nub bstan du bsgrigs/ pu tra ba rnams dang las tshan gyi gdan la lho chos khrims las thog lho byang gi grwa khrol/ chos 'khor lhun po ba rnams khri chen gyi shar dang / lho'i sa stegs dang mthil 'chams rwar mi gnod par tshogs/ rin chen sgang pa rnams dar chen gyi lho phyogs su dpungs/

zhal ngo dang / bla dpon mgron po drags rigs rab gsal thog kha sogs gang 'os/ khrom pa byings thig nang las mi 'da' ba'i sar tshogs grub pa dang / ru 'dren gyi bcom rol sgang dung dang dge slong nas/ skyes chung gi bar gyi ru 'dren spyan 'dren rnams yongs rdzogs btang / dge slong gi chems brdung la rkang gling spos phor ba 'thon tshul sogs nas bzung / chog bsgrigs bzhin byas la/ rnga chung pa gnyis gzan 'chams chas bzhin dang / dge slong rnams snam bu'i chos gos snam sbyar gang 'os g.yas su spyi blugs chu bcas/ rnga chung pa dge slong tshang ma grwa zhwa ser po zhwa lag g.yon nas mdun dkris/ dkyus zhwa rtse g.yas bstan du gyon tshogs kyi mtha' nas 'chams zhing bskor la dar chen gyi byang nas/ 'chams 'phro bcad cing bzhengs gral bsgrigs 'chams zhus pas 'chams rdzogs pa'i gsal byung ba dang rol mo 'jog tshul chog bsgrigs bzhin/ 'chams phyar gyi shar gyi mtha'i 'jabs gdan phyi mar gral 'go lho dang gral gzhug byang zhal nub bstan du dge slong rnga chung pa dang bcas pa gdan la bzhugs/ sngags pa'i bskul dang sngags 'chams pa rnams gzan 'chams chas ban phur mthing khra/ sngon nas gyon srol mi 'dug kyang dngos gzhi'i tshe zhwa nag yod ces pa'i brdar rtse zhwa dmar po/ dkyus dang zur zhwa dge slong bzhin la zhwa lag zhwa nang du cung zad bcug pa rkang gling pa'i zhwa bzhin gyon la gong bzhin 'chams nas/ dge slong dang cha 'dra ba'i 'jabs gdan la gral 'go shar dang gral gzhug nub zhal lhor bstan rdzogs mtshams dang bzhugs tshul gong bzhin/ bud med gyi bskul dang rnga chung pa'i rtse zhwa sngags pa bzhin 'chams pa rnams pho gos dmar po stod gos rgyan bcas gyon nas 'chams la chog bsgrigs bzhin log khro khang nas mang ja gsum yong ba'i dang po 'dir zhu zhing / ja gsum ka'ang mnyel chas pa ser skya gang yod dang / grwa btsun mang ja rgyun rgyug rnams la 'dren pa'i gang 'dren chas dang dkar yol 'bul 'grem phur bsgrub bzhin/

ja grub nas chab dang gung gseng / 'dus nas phub chen pa'i skul skyes 'chams rnga chung pa bcas rgyal lu chas/ g.yas gri lag long dang / g.yon shub thog nas dal chen gyi byang chub mtshams la langs gral dang / thams cad kyis grub nas g.yas bskor rang 'gros sngags pa'i gral bshams nas rnga rol rgyab 'khor mar gang gshom bsdad/ phub chung pa'i bskul dang / cha lugs 'chams tshul bcas 'dra bar byas nas/ skyes chen gyi gshom lho tal ma dang / shar la me lcags 'gug tu bsdad/ de nas lcam rol sgang dung / gnod sbyin yab yum gyi bskul tshig rkang drug byas/ gdong ma dang las mgon 'chams pa rnams ban ral thogs/ spos phor ba'i 'chams bcas chog bsgrigs bzhin/ dgu tshan bdun pa'i gnod sbyin yab yum rjes nged rang 'chams ran pa dang rnga gral pa'i sa nas 'chams khang gi sgor phyin te 'chams la de rjes dgu tshan bdun pa'i pu tra ming sring thon/ gcig brdung nas lnga brdung gi bar 'chams bskor rnams gnyis re/ gcig brdung rdzogs nas mang ja gnyis pa mchod skabs nged rang khrir 'khod/ gzhan rnams ru 'dren gyi nang gi gdan la bzhugs/ ja grub nas gung gseng 'dus nas 'chams kyi 'phros drug brdung gi 'gor dgug gzhug cig g.yas log g.yon log pad kor lcags 'then rnams grub nas mang ja gsum pa mchod tshul gong bzhin grub nas chab/ dpang gzugs drug brdung tshugs pa dang 'chams phyar gyi lho'i mthar pu tra 'chams pa rnams gral yug gcig la shongs na dang / de min phyi gral nang gral du gdan bsgyur/ drug brdung dang bdun brdung tshar gcig byas nas chems brdung tshugs pa dang nged rang khri la 'dug pu tra ba rnams lho nas byang gzigs gral gdan la bzhengs/ dkar dung dang dung chen drag dung / rnga chung pa dang bud med rnams chog bsgrigs bzhin rgyug nas du tsam zhig song ba dang / dkar dung dang dung chen drag dung nged rang gi mchod dpon pas snga rting gnyis la dar ring ba re dang /

gzhan rnams la thung ba re sprad tshar ba dang 'chams gral bsgrigs la 'chams gdan gyi lho nub khro khang gi thad tsam nas log 'chams blangs pa dang pu tra ba rnams gdan la bzhugs/ bud med kyi rjes su rnga chung pa sngon 'gro'i dge slong / de'i rjes su rnga chung pa sngon 'gro ba'i sngags pa mthud nas sgo mo'i gdong nar 'gros kyi rnam pas 'chams phyar gyi dkyil la byas log tshul dang / rnga chung pas dgug sdod sogs chog bsgrigs bzhin skyes chen skyes chung gi log 'chams kyang ru 'dren sngon ma gsum logs shul la byas nas logs la skyes chung 'chams gzhug pas 'chams skabs pu tra ba rnams 'chams rwar sgo'i 'chams sna dang / 'chams gzhug lho phyogs su byas pa'i bar der 'chams dpon phyin la chos dung rnga rol ba sogs langs/ rol sil gyi ber len pa sogs dang rgang dung rkang gling 'bud cing g.yab dar mi byed/ phyi nang gsang ba ma'i brgyad brdung grub nas dgu brdung gi gral sgor nar gyis rim bzhin log tshul chog bsgrigs bzhin dang / nged rang log tshul byas nas slar khri khar bsdad pa dang / dung rnga rol rnams kyang gral la 'khod/ 'chams rdzogs nas nged rang dpon g.yog dang / rnga rol ba sogs gral rim gong bzhin gyi gzhi thog tu byon nas gyes/ sngar nas rnga rol gyi g.yas g.yon sogs dang bstun ru 'dren bzhugs gsol 'dug kyang 'chams 'dis dngos bstan bsgral mchod yin pas 'chams dpon kha lho bltas kyi g.yas g.yon sogs la ru 'dren 'asgrig dgos pas so/ /nyer lnga gtor 'bul bcas rgyun bzhin nyer drug la dung shar skyar la btang nas nyer bdun gyi bskang gso de bsu ba tsam ma gtogs rgyun bzhin la shar pa'i gtor 'bul la sngags 'chang chen po'i gzigs snang las mgon lnga rnga rol gyis sngon la byon/ gzigs snang la ma shar gong gi cha lugs dang / khyad par mgon po'i man ngag dang mthun par nged rang nas bcos pa'i las mgon lnga rnga rol gyi rjes la byon la g.yab chen gyi lho'i g.yab steng 'chams gzhan rgyun bzhin/

'di nyid mdos chen gtong skabs 'chams dpon ma gtogs pa'i dge slong dang / skyes che chung rnga chung pa bcas kyi chas dang / gtor 'bul grub nas sngags pa dang pu tra ba rnga rol a tsar ba sogs chas gang dgos la mdzod pa 'khor bcas kyi 'chams chas rnams tho shar gyis rtsis sprad la ru 'dren 'chams chas rnams lha mthil dang / gser skyems pa/ sgo ma las mkhan gyi 'chams chas gos bem rol phod rnams gzhi thog tshoms dmar du rang rang gi bskyal la bzhag nyer bdun la tho snga dgong gsum gyi dung rgya gling cho ga tshang ma rgyun gyi nyer brgyad sor bzhag nub pa'i gtor 'bul la 'chams gong bzhin/ sa 'dul khrom zil gnon/ srod kyi rdzag dung bcas/ 'bag pa rnams kyis 'bag rnga sgrog rim 'bag shing gi rtsa bar rnga ma nag po dam par sbrags/ de steng dmar po rtse yar thon la rtsa ba dam du bsdam pa'i dpal rkang gi hrag la nag po'i dpal rkang sgo mar drangs pa'i steng sngon po rtse yar bstan la bsdams pa'i dpal rkang gi hrag la dmar po bton/ steng ljang khu rtse yar bstan gyi dpal rkang gi hrag la sngon po bton/ ljang khu'i dpal rkang yar drangs la bsdoms nas chab ste bzhag ces sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gsungs/ deng sang rnga rol gyi steng gos dar gyi lce le gang 'byor gtong ngo / /zor las pa lnga/ dur khrod bdag po gnyis/ bud med 'chams dpon rnams la nged rang nas bka' bsgo/ sa 'dul grub phral/ nyer brgyad 'chams kyi bca' bsgrigs bud med kyi chas tho shar nas sprad/ gyon mi so sos gzhan gyis ma mthong bar khur nas gzhi thog mdun bde yangs gur tu 'go pa'i ngag bkod bzhin sogs 'chams rgyun bzhin bca' bsgrigs/ sa skya tshogs su mnyam chas bzhin la rnga rol gral gyi dbus su nged rang gi khri chen mdun zur g.yas g.yon la gdan bkod kyi rim pa/ mkhan chen la sa gdan gos kyi thugs gdan nyis brtsegs grum tshe kha cha rgyab yol lcog rtse/

mdzod pa de mtshungs la rgyab yol mi dgos/ sgo grum gang yod kyi 'og tu 'bol dang / steng du kha char/ rnga rol dang / drung 'khor ser mo ba'i 'jabs gdan tshang ma gos gdan bcas dang / 'chams gdan gyi shar lho'i mtha' rkang gling pa'i gral gdan gyi rgyab tu/ bud med gtso mo'i khri sa pag brgyad brtsegs ras kyis g.yang gzhis btums pa rnams bshams/ nyer brgyad la tho snga dgong gsum gyi dung rgya gling dang / srod kyi rdzag dung rgyun bzhin tho mgo zin tsam la chos dung btang nas tshogs la gnas yo byin brlabs/ gtor ma'i rim pa/ zhu 'bul bdag mdun gtor bsngo bzhugs thog de kha nas bshags pa gsum byas la gung gseng / bskang ba thugs dam ma shur mar/ dkar chung shur mar/ sa skya'i rje btsun mar dbyangs bcas rgyun gyi nyer gsum bzhin dang / bstod pa nag rngams ma dbyangs res/ gtor 'bul ban tshang pa/ dbyangs chags bcas nyi shar sogs snga bar grub par byed/ 'di nyin snga bar 'phyar dar chen mo bcu gsum tshogs su sgrig cing de mdun spos dud bcas kyi do dam drung yig sogs kyis byed/ 'chams 'phyar gyi dbus su 'chams dpon gyi khri'u shing kha lho bstan/ mdun rtse mchod dpon pas g.yang gzhi bkram/ ru 'dren las mkhan dang bcas pa'i 'chams 'di'i rtsa ba kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa'i dgongs pa ni bskang gso rgyas par byed pa'i tshe'am/ mdos kyi tshe las mkhan gyi bskul dang bstun 'chams nas bsgral mchod mdzad par bzhed/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku thog la dus mdos nyer brgyad kyi snga chog grol nas mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gi bskang gso dang bshags pa'i mtshams su mdzad pa rnams ni 'brel chags la/ maṅga'i mtshan can gyi gzhug chog gi 'gor mdzad pa 'di gang gi'ang babs 'brel mi 'dug pas/ da nas bzung sngags 'chang chen po'i dgongs pa bzhin la a mes zhabs kyi chu sbrul lo dus mdos zhag bdun spor ba mdzad pa nas bzung cho ga tshar re las med pas gong du bshad pa bzhin bya'o/

/gser skyems pa/ spos phor ba/ rkang gling pa/ rdzag dung pa/ gdugs pa mchod dpon pa sogs 'chams chas dang / rol mo ba gsum/ sil snyan ba gsum la phod kha/ mkhan chen phebs na dang rnga pa gang yod la gos lcam/ chos dung pa dung gso/ mdung dar khyer mi gang yod dang dung chen pa phud dam phud phor ba gang yod/ rgya lu chas dang / ru 'dren sngon la 'thon dgos phar cher rnga chung pa dang bcas zhugs grub nas/ sa skya tshogs su chos dung thengs bdun btang / dung mkhan gzhi thog la yong ba dang / gzhi thog rtse nas 'chams la 'byon brda' sngar dngul dung dpal 'byor dar rgyas yin kyang / 'di lo nas bzung gser dung 'dzam gling dbang sdud btang 'phral gser skyems pa/ rnga rol ba dpon slob 'khor bcas chas te sna 'dren mgron gnyer gzhon pa/ mdung dar dkar po gnyis gshibs nas bzung / rdzag dung pa'i rjes kyi rgya gling pa cha gcig gi bar 'chams sku gdan 'dren bzhin bsgrigs/ de nas a tsa ra'i spos phor ba gnyis/ chos dung / rnga pa rol sil/ gser skyems pa bcu bzhi/ yang rgya gling pa chang phud dam phud phor ba gang yod mgron gnyer gcig drung 'khor skya bo khrol yod na de gras/ drung 'khor ser mo'i spos phor ba cha/ gsol dpon 'dren bcas lag khyer dang / mchod dpon a chas can/ nged rang lag 'dogs pa mdzod pa dang / gzim dpon/ gdugs a chas can gnyis/ mkhan chen yod na nged rang gi rjes su drung chen gnyis bcas drung 'khor ser skya gang yod rnams bsgrigs/ sgo rwa ba dang / rgyug dmar ba lo spe par rgyug pa sogs snga rting g.yas g.yon gang 'os su khrims gnon du phyin la/ mdung pa gang yod sa skya tshogs su khrom gyi thig nang g.yas 'khor du bskor la so so'i dbar che chung 'tshams pa'i bkod khyab dang / dung pa gang yod nub bstan du bsgrigs cing / skya bo pa dang / hwa shang gang 'os su sdod rgyu bcas kyi bkod khyab dpon yig dang /

mgron gnyer gnyis kyis byed/ khri'i g.yas la rol mo gsum/ rnga dpon/ bde gling dbu byed/ gzhan rnga pa gang rig g.yon du mkhan chen byon na dang / sil snyan pa gsum chos dung / yul chen slob dpon/ grong chen slob dpon sogs rnga pa gang yod bsgrigs/ g.yang gzhi'i lag rtse gnyis dang nye ba a tsa ra'i spos phor ba re re kha lho bstan du bsdad/ rnga rol pa'i g.yas g.yon du drung 'khor gyi spos phor ba gnyis/ g.yang gzhi spyi bo'i thad du nged rang kha byang bstan/ de'i mthar gser skyems pa bcu bzhi yangs dog 'tshams khri'u shing gi rgyab nas bskor/ rol mo nas 'di bar mchod dpon a tsa ra'i bkod pa byed/ zla bo rnams so so'i gral la langs nas 'khod tshar ba dang / phud phor bas phud phor bskyed la/ de nang 'bru cung zad dor blug phud dam pa'i skyems phud phor gyi phyed tsam re blugs tshar ba dang / dam phor khyer mi rnams gser skyems 'chams gral gyi mthar 'khod/ rnga dpon gyis bdud rtsi byin rlabs bskul la/ rdo rje ljid dang ldan par gyur zhes sogs tshugs pa dang / dkar rgyang pas bcom dung dal ring gnyis rdzogs nas rnga blangs la/ bcom rol sogs gser skyems chog bsgrigs bzhin la/ 'chams rol re re rdzogs nas gser skyems 'thor tshul byas la ka ṭo ra sogs su blugs nas/ yang gser skyems bshams pa kun la 'gre/ rjes ma'i tshe steng bar 'og gsum du 'thor tshul gyis spo thang gsum dang / 'og tu 'thor yang g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis lcer myangs/ phud phor rnams chus bshal la bsdus/ nged rang gi phud phor de khri'i lcog rtse'i steng mañdzi la skyems kyis bkang nas bzhag pa'i g.yas su phud dam bzhag gser skyems bsags pa rnams phud phor ba gang rung gi 'chams khang gi mdun dang / ltag sgo brgyud/ bya khra ma'i gung nas phyogs mtshams brgyad du gtor rol mo sum brdeg lan can grub nas 'chams pa rnams gral bsgrigs nas 'chams khang du log pa'i rjes su nged rang phyin la rnga khral gyi khrir bsdad/

gser skyems 'di rnams 'thor ba don thob la yod kyang / nam zla'i stabs 'chams 'phyar dang 'chams rwar 'khyags pa ches tshe nor skyong 'chams pa sogs la mi bde bas 'di bzhin bya'o/ /gzhan rnams kyis langs mu de ka nas snyom chas bzhin bcom rol sngon 'gro'i bskul tshugs pa dang / a tsa ra'i spos phor ba gnyis 'chams khang du phyin/ dge slong gi chems brdung byung ba dang / rkang gling spos phor ba 'thon tshul sogs chog bsgrigs bzhin byas la/ lhung bzed du 'bru cung zad dang bcas dge slong rnams thon/ dge slong gnyis pa 'thon byung ba dang / rnga rol chos dung bcas gral la 'dug dung rkang gling g.yab dar gyi mtshams bcas gong bzhin/ gser skyems kyi bcom rol dang / bud med kyi 'chams bdun dang brdung / bud med sha skal la rgyugs pa rnams la dung chen rdzag dung gang yod 'bud/ 'chams gzhan la cha rnams re mos/ rgya gling 'chams so so 'thon pa'i chems brdung dang 'chams gzhug pas 'chams 'jog ma ran tsam la cha gnyis re mos kyis 'bud/ 'chams tshul gral rim snyom chas bzhin la dog g.yog ces btsun chung zhwa gos sogs gzabs spros can gyi lhung shub gdeng ba spyi blugs rnams khyer nas do rwa'i phyir dge slong re dang mnyam du rang 'gros kyis 'gro srol 'dug 'chams grub nas rnga chung pa gnyis 'chams du log dge slong 'chams gzhug pas 'chams pa'i tshe rnga rol dung bcas sngags pa bskul ba'i phyir langs/ de bzhin du log 'dug 'di bzhin 'og ma thams cad la rigs 'gre/ dge slong gi 'chams rol mo 'jog mtshams bcas rdzogs pa dang / sngags pa bud med gnyis mnyam chas bzhin la sngags pa'i rnga chung pa 'chams khang du log bud med 'chams grub nas ja dang po khro khang nas zhu gong gsol dpon dang / mkhan chen phebs tshe drung chen 'dren dpon 'dren g.yog bcas kyi 'dren chas dang / dkar yol bteg 'grem gyi rim pa mdzod pa dang /

drung 'khor ser mo ba gang yod/ rnga rol/ gdugs pa/ sngags pa dang / dge slong gi 'chams 'go pa gnyis dang / 'chams gzhug pa rnams bskyed nas ja btang / 'chams gral du ma 'khod pa'i 'chams pa rnams la 'chams khang gi nang dang / gzhi thog gi mdun rdo bcal sogs gang 'os su 'dren/ ja mchod ring dung chen gang 'os dang / rgya gling cha gcig gtong / grub nas rnga rol sngags pa rnams la rtse mchod dpon pas chab btang nas gung gseng la gyes/ 'dus nas gzhan rnams gral la 'khod/ rnga rol pa langs nas phub chen po'i bskul grub pa dang / gral la 'khod nas phub chen pa 'thon/ de bzhin du phub chung ba yang 'gre/ phub chung rdzogs nas ja gnyis pa rung khang byang nas gtong ja grub nas chab btang la/ rnga rol pa langs nas bcom rol sogs nor skyong 'chams bskor chog bsgrigs dang phur bsgrub bzhin la nor skyong 'chams pa gnyis kyi 'chams kha rdo skas thad nas rim gyis 'chams phyar gyi dbus sogs su yong la/ baṃ 'dzin lho'i khrom nang mdung pa sogs dang mi thug pa'i sar 'dug pa de nas g.yas g.yon du dgu brdung la rgyug pa'i tshe gcig nub tu rgyug pa'i mu nas rnga pa'i rgyab la phyin/ chos khri'i mdun sogs gang slebs dang / gcig shar du rgyug mu nas byang phyogs su phyin te dar chen gyi mdun sogs gang slebs su 'chams shing / liṅga len pa dang log 'chams ni phur bsgrub kyi rig 'gre shes/ de grub nas gung gseng / pu tra 'chams pa rnams kyis tshoms dmar nas 'chams chas gyon tshar ba dang / rnga rol ba rnams kyis bskul sogs chog bsgrigs bzhin la/ gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra lcam sring / sgo ma rnams kyis bskul/ yongs rdzogs grub nas rkang gling spos phor ba sngon 'gro'i 'chams pa rnams chog bsgrigs bzhin 'thon/ 'chams dpon gyis lam 'gros 'phro bcad pa dang rnga rol ba sogs gral la 'khod/ gcig brdung nas lnga brdung gi bar gyi 'chams rnams gsum re spor gcig brdung gsum mjug gi 'gros bcas grub nas spyi pa gzhung gi ja 'bul tshan bcas/

ja grub nas chab/ nyis brdung nas lnga brdung rdzogs pa'i bzhi 'gros kyi bar de nas gung gseng 'dus nas ja gsum pa rung khang byang / chab btang grub nas rnga rol rnams langs/ ru 'dren rnams kyang rang rang gi phyag mtshan thogs nas langs/ pu tra ba rnams kyis do rwa bskor/ 'chams dpon gyis rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad kyis phyag rgyas bzung la/ rnga rol ba rnams kyis dgug gzhug gsum lha dbye rnams rgyun bzhin rol mo bcas byed skabs 'bag pa rnams 'bag sprugs kyis liṅga btub/ lha dbye rdzogs nas 'chams dpon gyi'ang 'bag sprug ci rigs byas la/ g.yas log g.yon log pad skor lcags 'then rnams grub nas/ drug brdung dpang gzugs dang / 'das dang ma gnyis bdun brdung bcas byas la/ ja bzhi pa khro khang / yang sngar bzhin thams cad langs nas/ drug brdung dpal ldan mgon po dang / bdun brdung grub nas 'chams dpon liṅga sgrol bar chas pa dang / 'bag pa rnams gong bzhin btub/ 'chams dpon gyis shā sa na bzla bzhin pas sgrol dmigs dang sgrol tshul drug cu pa bzhin byas la bsha' ba'i stangs ka byas/ mchod dpon pas sha thum nas glo snying nang khrol sna tshogs liṅga dang g.yang gzhi'i khar dmar nyog tu bton tshar ba dang / pu tra ba rnams mnyam chas bzhin gral la 'khod/ dkar dung dang dung chen drag dung bud med rnga chung pa gnyis 'chams khang nas rgyug shar gyis 'thon te/ 'chams phyar gyi lho mthar byang bstan du 'khod pa dang / bud med rnams mnyam chas bzhin rgyug la mthar gtso mo khri steng du 'khod/ lag pa dang ral pa sogs kyi g.yab pa dang / su ki sgra sogs phyogs kun tu rnam 'gyur gang thon byas pa dang / 'chams pa gzhan rnams khri drung du tshogs/ sha skal che chung la kha shas kyis sho 'phangs tshul byas nas shor thob byung tshul gyi gad mo'i sgra dang rnam 'gyur ci yang grub bstun liṅga'i rtsar rub tu nye ba dang / rkang gling pa gnyis g.yang gzhi'i lag rtse gnyis phyogs su 'dug la/

dpung chang bsrung ba lta bus g.yab dar rang lus phan tshun du g.yugs/ mchod dpon a tsar ling drung du bsdad la klad pa glo snying nang khrol mtshon tsam zhig phyi nang gsang ba mar phud 'bul ched snod gcig tu bzhag gzhan sha sna rnams gtso mo dang bud med lag su bde la sprad nas/ phyogs mtshams su gyes tshar ba dang / rkang gling pa gnyis rang gral du bsdad/ bud med 'chams gzhug pa des dgra bgegs kyi ro sgang po za bar 'dod tshul gyis mchod dpon a tsar bar rnam 'gyur/ sna tshogs dum tsam zhig bstan la/ mchod dpon pas kyang zhags pa liṅga la dam du dkris nas sprad do/ /g.yang gzhi dang 'chams dpon gyis rdor dril lcog rtse sogs bsdus/ nged rang rnga rol gyi khri khar 'ongs/ khri'u shing gdan bcas kyang bsdus nas/ bud med liṅga khyer ba des rgyug shar ci rigs grub pa dang / ru 'dren rnams mnyam chas bzhin log bud med log 'chams tshugs pa dang / rnga rol pu tra ba rnams gral la bzhugs skyes che chung rdzogs pa dang / 'bag pa'i gras pu tra dang gzig gdong mar bandha yod pas 'chams dpon gyis bandhar klad pa dang / gzhan rnams su sha sna mchod dpon pas phyi nang gsang ba'i dbyangs tshugs pa dang 'gyed/ nyi zla sogs g.yon gyi phyag mtshan gzhan yod rigs la mi dgos/ brgyad brdung nas bzung nged rang dpon slob gzhi thog tu 'ong ba'i bar mnyam chas bzhin la/ slar yang myur du 'chams pa'i rten 'brel 'chams pa tshang mas 'chams khang gi sgo nas phyir bltas byed/ nged rang log 'chams grub nas/ 'chams khang gi sgo nang du 'bag phud/ zhwa thebs gyon nas slar yang khri khar 'khod do/ /nyer dgu rgyun bzhin la/ tho snga'i dung rgya gling dmag dung bcas dang / dung rkang gling 'khar rnga hwa shang dung rgya gling rdzag dung rnams 'chams sku gdan 'dren bzhin dang dar khra mi dgos/ bud med ma gtogs pa'i ru 'dren tshang ma nyer brgyad bzhin la dge slong lhung bzed shubs bcas/

las mgon lnga tshar gnyis/ 'chams sku dang / g.yag gzengs 'phar ma bcas 'byon tshul tho zur bzhin/ sa skya tshogs nas bzung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe rnga rol rdzogs mtshams 'bag pa'i gdong der bu mo mda' dar can/ rnga rol 'chams sku bcas kyi g.yon nas dge slong / 'chams sku dang slob dpon gyi rgyab nas zor las pa sogs sngags pa g.yas g.yon du me lcags 'gugs/ skyes che chung gang yod g.yas ru g.yon ru rgyab ru bcas bya khra ma nas g.yul thod sogs su chas pa dang gtor ma ma thob bar la me mda'i skad ci rigs/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma grub nas/ skyes che chung ma gtogs/ gzhan tshang ma gzhi thog tu byon nas/ rnga rol dung rkang gling sogs 'chams sku gdan 'dren bzhin dang dge slong rnams tshoms chen mdo'i rgyug grwa byang nas mgron gnyer shag gi bar la zhal shar bstan du bsgrigs/ sngags pa rnams lho'i skya 'gram la nub nas shar du byang bstan la bsgrigs/ bu mo rnams sum skas kyi shar du lhor bstan la bsgrigs/ 'chams sku'i sku 'chams grub nas gyes tshar ba dang / phyag mdzod rab gsal nas dar brda' byung bstun bya khra mar dmag pa rnams kyis lha rgyal/ skyes che chung gis sbad shod ci rigs grub nas/ rkang dmag mdung pa dang / rta pa rnams rgyun bzhin bsdad/ skyes che chung rnams sa skya tshogs su chang ston la tshogs/ chang 'thung grub nas gyes gzhung dang mi ser gyi rta rgyugs grub pa dang lha rgyal/ dmag ston bzhugs gral rgyun bzhin/ gnam gang bskang gso brgya tshar rgyun bzhin la gos gzab spros/ tshes gcig mnga' gsol rgyun bzhin la tshogs pa gang yod kyis gos lcam gyon gtor 'bul dang 'chams sku phebs skyel ran pa dang / mdung pa sogs tshang ma gdan 'dren bzhin bca' bsgrigs dang / rol mo bas gos kyi snam sbyar chos gos sogs gyon/ gtor 'bul sogs kyi skabs bskang gso brgya tshar gyi spyan gzigs dang khrab rmog lda ldi tshogs tshoms chen gyi drag chas rnams tshang ma bsdus/

lda ldi'i shul la nor bu'i phreng ba bkram/ gzhan tshang ma rgyun bzhin lo gsar bzhugs gral bcas mdzad/ de'i sang nyin nas bzung gtor spod rnams rgyun bzhin la/ mgon khang khag bzhir gzab spros phrin bcol bzhin/ nang so'i gtor 'bul dang chabs cig 'dzugs gtor 'bul stabs/ pu tra bskul ja/ ja mchod nam mkha' 'brug sgra'i sde tshan rnams sgrub mchod so so'i gtor 'bul bzhin la/ deng sang gi sa yul nang so mgon khang mdo'i nas khang sogs kyi steng nas rnga pa byang bstan kho na la bya'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i chog bsgrigs dus mdos phyag deb/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
